item.title: Lawmaker Lee Un-ju Criticizes Government EV Subsidies: "Should Go to Producers, Not Buyers... Otherwise China Will Take It All" (與 이언주, 정부 전기차 보조금 비판 “구매자 아닌 생산자에 줘야… 아니면 중국에 다 빼앗겨”)
item.description:
Lawmaker Lee Un-ju Criticizes Government EV Subsidies: "Should Go to Producers, Not Buyers... Otherwise China Will Take It All" (與 이언주, 정부 전기차 보조금 비판 “구매자 아닌 생산자에 줘야… 아니면 중국에 다 빼앗겨”)

Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Un-ju criticized the government's electric vehicle subsidy policy. (더불어민주당 이언주 의원이 정부의 전기차 보조금 정책을 비판했다.)

On the morning of the 14th, the lawmaker shared on Facebook an article reporting that Chinese-made vehicles' share of the domestic EV market has risen to 35.0%, yet the government's tax reform proposal announced on the 3rd excluded domestic production from tax credit eligibility. (이 의원은 14일 오전 페이스북에 국내 전기차 시장에서 중국산의 점유율이 35.0%로 높아졌으나, 정부가 지난 3일 발표한 세제 개편안에서는 국내 생산 세액 공제 대상에서 빠졌다는 내용의 기사를 공유했다.)

In response, Lee said, "I've been raising similar concerns repeatedly for years, but little has changed." She added, "China has been providing 'producer subsidies' paid directly to manufacturers. In contrast, South Korea, for environmental protection, has been giving 'consumer subsidies' through the Ministry of Climate and Energy to promote the adoption of eco-friendly vehicles, whether Chinese or Korean. We've been using taxpayers' money to subsidize buyers of imported cars, including Chinese ones, leaving EVs made by our workers on our soil at a competitive disadvantage." She further argued, "As a result, Chinese cars benefit from producer subsidies at home and consumer subsidies in Korea—double benefits—while Korean cars face reverse discrimination." (이 의원은 이와 관련해 “몇 년째 반복해서 유사한 문제 제기를 해 왔는데도 좀처럼 바뀌지 않는다”고 했다. 그는 “중국은 보조금을 생산자에게 지급하는 ‘생산자 보조금’을 지급해 왔는데, 우리나라는 환경 보호를 위해 그간 기후에너지환경부가 그게 중국차든 한국차든 친환경 자동차 보급 차원에서 ‘구매자 보조금’을 줬다”며 “중국차 등 수입차에도 우린 국민 혈세로 구매자 보조금을 계속 줘서, 우리 땅에서 우리 노동자가 만든 전기차가 결과적으로 경쟁에서 밀리는 상황이 됐다”고 했다. 그러면서 “결과적으로 중국차는 자국에서 생산자 보조금도 받고, 한국에서 구매자 보조금도 받고, 이중 혜택을 받는 바람에 한국차는 역차별을 받게 된 셈”이라고 했다.)

Lee asserted, "In the modern world, the most important independence is technological independence and securing technological sovereignty. The only reason we're still holding on is that, amid the U.S.-China hegemonic rivalry, Korea has positioned itself as a strategic alternative to Chinese manufacturing, buying us time." (이 의원은 “현대 사회에서 가장 중요한 독립은 기술 독립이고 기술 주권의 확보”라며 “그나마 우리가 지금 이 정도라도 버티는 것은 미·중 패권 경쟁 틈바구니에서 한국이 중국 제조의 전략적 대안으로 포지셔닝되어 시간을 벌었기 때문”이라고 주장했다.)

She continued, "But we don't know how much of that time remains. Ahead of tomorrow's Liberation Day, I want to stress once again: above environmental ideals or humanitarian principles, the priority must be national interest, sovereignty, and the survival of our own industries and citizens." (이 의원은 이어 “그러나 그 시간마저 얼마나 남았는지는 모르겠다”며 “내일 광복절을 앞두고 다시 한번 강조한다. 환경, 인도주의, 이런 이상보다도 우선하는 가치는 바로 국익과 주권, 자국 산업과 자국민의 생존”이라고 했다.)

She said, "Isn't it enough to regret after losing everything, as we did in the past due to such foolishness? The tax reform proposal omits tax credits for Korean-made EVs, so I will submit a revision bill." (그는 “다 빼앗기고 나서 후회하는 건 과거의 어리석음으로 족하지 않은가”라며 “한국산 전기차 생산 세액 공제에 관한 내용이 세제 개편안에 빠져 있는데, 개정안을 제출하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Kazakhstan Workers to Arrive Starting 2028… Employment Permit System Sending Countries Expand to 18 (2028년부터 카자흐스탄 근로자 들어온다… 고용 허가제 송출국 18국으로 확대)
item.description:
Kazakhstan Workers to Arrive Starting 2028… Employment Permit System Sending Countries Expand to 18 (2028년부터 카자흐스탄 근로자 들어온다… 고용 허가제 송출국 18국으로 확대)

The government has added Kazakhstan to the list of countries allowed to send low-skilled workers to South Korea as of the 14th. (정부가 한국에 저숙련 근로자를 보낼 수 있는 국가로 14일 카자흐스탄을 추가 지정했다.)

The Office for Government Policy Coordination announced that it held the 49th Foreign Workforce Policy Committee meeting that morning at the Government Complex Seoul and the Government Complex Sejong, chaired by the Deputy Prime Minister for Economic Affairs and Minister of the Office for Government Policy Coordination, Im Ki-geun, where it confirmed the agenda item designating Kazakhstan as a sending country under the Employment Permit System (EPS). (국무총리실은 이날 오전 정부서울청사와 세종청사에서 임기근 국무조정실장 주재로 49차 외국인력정책위원회를 열어, 카자흐스탄을 고용 허가제 송출국으로 지정하는 안건을 확정했다고 밝혔다.)

Under the EPS, the government accepts low-skilled workers only from countries designated as labor-sending nations. Foreigners entering through this system are granted "non-professional employment" (E-9) visas and may only work in designated sectors, including manufacturing, construction, agriculture and livestock, fisheries, and construction waste processing. Their permitted stay in the country is limited to 4 years and 10 months. (정부는 고용 허가제를 통해, 인력 송출국으로 지정한 국가에서만 제한적으로 저숙련 근로자를 받아들이고 있다. 이를 통해 들어오는 외국인에게는 ‘비전문 취업’(E-9) 비자가 부여되고, 이들은 제조업, 건설업, 농축산업, 어업, 건설 폐기물 처리업 등 지정된 업종에만 취업할 수 있다. 국내 체류 기간은 4년 10개월로 제한된다.)

The sending countries previously numbered 17—China, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Kyrgyzstan, Mongolia, Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam, Thailand, Myanmar, Cambodia, Laos, Timor-Leste, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nepal, and Sri Lanka—but with the addition of Kazakhstan, this has increased to 18. The population of the existing 17 countries is approximately 2.6 billion, while Kazakhstan has about 21 million people. (송출국은 중국, 우즈베키스탄, 타지키스탄, 키르기스스탄, 몽골, 인도네시아, 필리핀, 베트남, 태국, 미얀마, 캄보디아, 라오스, 동티모르, 파키스탄, 방글라데시, 네팔, 스리랑카 등 17국이었으나, 카자흐스탄 추가 지정으로 18국으로 늘었다. 기존 17국의 인구는 약 26억명, 카자흐스탄은 약 2100만명이다.)

Regarding the designation of additional sending countries, the government explained that it aims to "diversify sending countries, respond more effectively to on-site demand for labor introduction, and further solidify bilateral cooperation." (정부는 송출국 추가 지정에 대해 “송출국을 다변화하고 현장의 인력 도입 수요에 보다 효과적으로 대응하며, 양국 간 협력 관계를 더욱 공고히 하기 위한 것”이라고 설명했다.)

On the designation of Kazakhstan, it stated, "Kazakhstan has government and public institutions dedicated to handling labor dispatch, making it possible to ensure the public nature and transparency of the dispatch process. It was assessed that there are no particular issues in securing key infrastructure such as pre-employment training facilities, Employment Permit System centers, and health examination facilities for worker selection." It added, "We also confirmed Kazakhstan's willingness to cooperate, including institutional improvements to prevent illegal stay." (카자흐스탄을 지정한 것에 대해서는 “송출 업무를 전담할 수 있는 정부·공공기관을 두고 있어 송출 과정의 공공성과 투명성 확보가 가능하며, 인력 선발을 위한 사전 취업 교육 시설, 고용 허가제 센터, 건강 검진 시설 등 주요 인프라 확보에도 특별한 문제점이 없는 것으로 평가됐다”고 했다. “불법 체류 방지를 위한 제도 개선 등 카자흐스탄의 협력 의지도 확인했다”고 했다.)

Kazakhstan workers are expected to begin arriving in earnest starting 2028. The government said, "To ensure no disruptions in labor introduction, we will continue cooperation with Kazakhstan to sign a government-to-government MOU on the EPS and establish a local Employment Permit System center." (카자흐스탄 근로자들은 2028년부터 본격적으로 들어올 예정이다. 정부는 “인력 도입에 차질이 없도록, 정부 간 고용 허가제 MOU(양해 각서) 체결, 현지 고용 허가제 센터 설치 등을 위해 카자흐스탄과 협력을 지속해 나갈 것”이라고 했다.)

The government also announced partial changes to the operation of the Employment Permit System for foreign workers in the construction sector. (정부는 건설업 분야의 외국인 근로자 고용 허가제 운영 방식도 일부 변경했다고 밝혔다.)

Previously, employment permits and employment restriction measures were implemented on a per-construction-site basis, meaning reassigning foreign workers to different construction sites was only possible in limited cases, such as when work at the original site had been completed or halted. Additionally, employment restriction measures imposed when an employer violated labor laws applied only to the site where the violation occurred and did not extend to the employer's other sites, leading to criticism that they had little effect. (기존에는 건설 현장 단위로 고용 허가와 고용 제한 조치가 이뤄져, 외국인 근로자를 다른 건설 현장에 재배치하는 것은 기존 현장 공사가 종료됐거나 중단된 경우 등 제한적인 경우에만 가능했다. 또 고용자가 노동법을 위반한 경우 부과되는 고용 제한 조치는 법 위반이 발생한 현장에만 국한되고 동일 고용자의 다른 현장에는 효력이 미치지 않아, 큰 효과가 없다는 지적이 많았다.)

Accordingly, the government has decided to allow employers to reassign foreign workers to other sites and to extend the application of employment restriction measures to all construction sites under the same employer. (이에 따라 정부는 고용자가 외국인 근로자를 다른 현장으로 재배치할 수 있게 하고, 고용 제한 조치도 동일 고용자의 모든 공사 현장에 대해 확대 적용하기로 했다.)

item.title: People Power Party tells presidential office floating 4-year re-election system: "Stop attempting constitutional amendment for a change of pace" (野, 4년 중임 대통령제 띄운 靑에 “국면 전환용 개헌 시도 중단하라”)
item.description:
People Power Party tells presidential office floating 4-year re-election system: "Stop attempting constitutional amendment for a change of pace" ( 野, 4년 중임 대통령제 띄운 靑에 “국면 전환용 개헌 시도 중단하라”)

The People Power Party on the 14th responded to the presidential office floating discussions on a 4-year re-election presidential system, saying it aims to "complement the problems of the imperial presidency," by stating, "This is an attempt to break through the president's legal risks through a constitutional amendment" and "Stop the constitutional amendment attempt meant to change the narrative." (국민의힘은 14일 청와대가 제왕적 대통령제의 문제점을 보완하겠다며 4년 중임 대통령제 관련 논의를 띄운 데 대해 “대통령의 사법 리스크를 개헌으로 돌파하려는 것” “국면 전환용 개헌 시도를 중단하라”고 했다.)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk posted on his Facebook that afternoon, asking, "In our history, has there ever been an 'imperial' president like President Lee Jae-myung?" He added, "The presidential office's position on the constitutional amendment is that it empathizes with the problems of the imperial presidential-centered system." (국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 이날 오후 자신의 페이스북에 글을 올리고 “우리 역사에 이재명 대통령 같은 ‘제왕적’ 대통령이 있었느냐”고 했다. 그는 “제왕적 대통령 중심제가 가진 문제점에 공감하고 있다는 게 개헌에 대한 청와대 입장”이라며 이같이 말했다.)

He then said, "They tore down the entire judicial system of the Republic of Korea to eliminate their own trial," and "They ignore the public's voice on housing policy and stock market policy and do whatever they want. They are pushing through the abolition of supplementary investigative powers and the integration of military academies no matter how much the people oppose it." He continued, "I repeat, the precondition for a constitutional amendment is simple. President Lee Jae-myung should declare that he will serve only one term as president." (그러면서 “자기 재판 없애겠다고 대한민국 사법 체계를 몽땅 다 허물었다”며 “부동산 정책, 증시 정책, 국민의 목소리는 무시하고 하고 싶은 대로 다 한다. 보완 수사권 폐지, 사관학교 통합, 국민이 아무리 반대해도 밀어붙이고 있다”고 했다. 이어 “거듭 말하지만 개헌의 전제 조건은 간단하다. 이재명 대통령 스스로 대통령 한 번만 하겠다고 선언하면 된다”고 했다.)

Floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik also criticized, saying, "The presidential office is directly coming forward and openly pushing for a constitutional amendment for a re-election system." He said, "No matter what modifiers the presidential office attaches to the constitutional amendment—'power-sharing system,' 'problems of the imperial presidency,' 'strengthening National Assembly powers'—the essence is one," adding, "This is an attempt at a 'prison-break constitutional amendment' to break through the president's legal risks through constitutional revision." (정점식 원내대표도 “청와대가 직접 나서 중임제 개헌을 노골화하고 있다”고 비판했다. 그는 “청와대가 개헌 앞에 ‘분권형’이니, ‘제왕적 대통령제의 문제’니, ‘국회 권한 강화’니 하며 수식어를 갈아 끼워도 본질은 하나”라며 “대통령의 사법 리스크를 개헌으로 돌파하려는 ‘탈옥형 개헌’의 시도”라고 했다.)

Floor leader Jeong said, "If President Lee Jae-myung has even a trace of sincerity about a constitutional amendment, he should come before the people and first promise 'there will be no re-election' and 'I will stand trial immediately.'" He added, "Without such promises, any constitutional amendment discussions by the government and ruling party can receive no public trust and can seek no cooperation from any opposition party." (정 원내대표는 “이재명 대통령이 정말 개헌에 손톱만한 진정성이라도 있다면, 국민 앞에 나와서 ‘연임은 없다’ ‘당장 재판받겠다’는 약속부터 해야 한다”고 했다. 그러면서 “이런 약속이 없다면, 정부와 여당의 개헌 논의는 그 어떤 국민적 신뢰도 받을 수 없고 그 어떤 야당의 협조도 구할 수 없다”고 했다.)

Lawmaker Kim Jae-seop of the same party also posted on Facebook that day, saying, "Claiming that because the imperial presidency is a problem, we should switch to a 4-year re-election system is deceiving the people." He said, "They don't think about laying down the enormous powers they hold themselves—does touching only the term length solve the problem of the imperial presidency?" adding, "This is not correcting the imperial presidency. It is turning the imperial presidency into a 4-year re-election monarchy." (같은 당 김재섭 의원도 이날 자신의 페이스북에 “제왕적 대통령제가 문제니까 4년 중임제로 바꾸자는 건 국민 기만”이라고 했다. 그는 “스스로 가진 비대한 권한을 내려놓을 생각은 하지 않고, 임기만 건드린다고 제왕적 대통령제 문제가 해결되느냐”며 “이건 제왕적 대통령제를 바로잡는 것이 아니다. 제왕적 대통령제를 4년 중임 군주제로 바꾸자는 것”이라고 했다.)

People Power Party senior spokesperson Park Choong-kwon said, "A constitutional amendment is not a 'card for changing the narrative' to be pulled out according to the political needs of a president or a particular administration," and "Immediately stop the 'tactical constitutional amendment attempt' to evade the administration's crisis and extend its power." (국민의힘 박충권 수석대변인은 “헌법 개정은 대통령이나 특정 정권의 정치적 필요에 따라 꺼내드는 ‘국면 전환용 카드’가 아니다”라며 “정권의 위기를 모면하고 권력을 연장하기 위한 ‘정략적 개헌 시도’를 즉각 중단하라”고 했다.)

Earlier, the presidential office stated regarding the direction of the power-structure constitutional amendment pursued by President Lee Jae-myung, "We believe a 4-year re-election presidential system with strengthened National Assembly powers has the highest public acceptability." A presidential office official told reporters that day, "Since the intention is to complement the limitations of the imperial presidency with a re-election presidential system, it is not a cabinet system," adding, "It also does not specify or refer to a power-sharing presidential system." (앞서 청와대는 이재명 대통령이 추구하는 권력 구조 개헌의 방향성과 관련해 “국회의 권한이 강화된 4년 중임 대통령제가 국민적 수용성이 가장 높다고 생각하고 있다”고 밝혔다. 청와대 관계자는 이날 기자들과 만나 “제왕적 대통령제의 한계를 중임제 대통령제로 보완하겠다는 것이므로, 내각제는 아니다”라며 “분권형 대통령제 등을 특정하거나 지칭하는 것도 아니다”라고 했다.)

item.title: Lee Jin-sook 'May 18 Re-examination Forum'... Ruling Party Submits Motion Calling for Expulsion (이진숙 ‘5·18 재조명 포럼’... 與, 제명 촉구 결의안 제출)
item.description:
Lee Jin-sook 'May 18 Re-examination Forum'... Ruling Party Submits Motion Calling for Expulsion (이진숙 ‘5·18 재조명 포럼’... 與, 제명 촉구 결의안 제출)

The Democratic Party of Korea submitted a motion on the 14th calling for the expulsion of Lee Jin-sook, a lawmaker from the People Power Party, who held a forum on the May 18 Gwangju Democratization Movement at the National Assembly alongside a right-wing group. (더불어민주당은 국회에서 우파 단체와 함께 5·18 광주 민주화운동에 관한 포럼을 개최한 이진숙 국민의힘 의원에 대한 제명 촉구 결의안을 14일 제출했다.)

The Democratic Party submitted the 'Motion Calling for the Expulsion of Lawmaker Lee Jin-sook for Distorting and Denigrating May 18' to the National Assembly Secretariat in the name of all its lawmakers that day. Rep. Park Gyun-taek, the deputy floor leader, and Rep. Lee Ju-hee, the floor spokesperson, who directly submitted the motion, told reporters, "This lawmaker must immediately step down from her position." (민주당은 이날 소속 국회의원 전원 명의로 ‘5·18 왜곡·폄훼 이진숙 국회의원 제명 촉구 결의안’을 국회사무처에 제출했다. 결의안을 직접 제출한 박균택 원내부대표와 이주희 원내대변인은 기자들과 만나 “이 의원은 당장 국회의원직에서 물러나야 한다”고 했다.)

Floor spokesperson Lee said, "She gathered figures who denigrate the spirit of May 18 and did not hesitate to deny even historically confirmed facts," adding, "She is unfit to be a lawmaker." Rep. Park also said, "Seeing her push ahead with the forum despite opposition from her own party, she is a substandard politician who cannot be reformed through rational means," adding, "We have no choice but to call for her expulsion." (이 원내대변인은 “이 의원은 5·18 정신을 폄훼하는 인사들을 모아 역사적으로 확정된 사실조차 부정하는 행위를 서슴지 않았다”면서 “국회의원으로서 자격이 없다”고 말했다. 박 의원도 “소속 정당에서도 반대했는데도 토론회를 강행하는 모습을 보면 합리적 방법으로는 개조가 불가능한 함량 미달 정치인”이라면서 “제명을 촉구할 수밖에 없다”고 했다.)

A motion to expel a lawmaker is brought to a plenary session after review by the National Assembly's Ethics Committee and consultation with the Ethics Advisory Council. If the expulsion is passed with the approval of two-thirds or more of lawmakers in a plenary session, the lawmaker loses their seat. However, the only actual case of expulsion was that of former President Kim Young-sam in 1979. Rep. Park said, "We should use this incident as an opportunity to quickly form the National Assembly Ethics Committee, which has not yet been constituted." (국회의원 제명안은 국회 윤리특별위원회의 심사와 윤리심사자문위원회의 의견 청취를 거치면 본회의에 상정된다. 본회의에서 국회의원 3분의 2 이상 찬성으로 제명 처분이 가결되면 해당 의원은 의원직을 상실한다. 다만 실제 제명이 이뤄진 사례는 1979년 김영삼 전 대통령이 유일하다. 박 의원은 “아직까지 구성되지 않고 있는 국회 윤리특위를 이번 사건을 계기로 빨리 구성해야 한다”고 했다.)

The previous day, Lee held the 'National Assembly Open Forum on Re-examining the May 18 Democratization Movement' jointly with the civic group New History National Movement at the National Assembly Library. At the forum, remarks were made describing the May 18 Gwangju Democratization Movement as a "riot." The Democratic Party strongly criticized this as a "historical coup." (이 의원은 전날 국회도서관에서 시민단체 새역사국민운동과 공동으로 ‘5·18 민주화운동의 재조명 국회 공개포럼’을 개최했다. 이 포럼에선 5·18 광주 민주화운동에 대해 “소요 사태”라는 등의 발언이 나왔다. 민주당은 이를 “역사 쿠데타”라며 강하게 비판했다.)

item.title: Election Commission Special Counsel Recommendation Committee Recommends Lee Tae-han and Lee Hyuk as Special Counsel Candidates (선관위 특검 추천위, 특검 후보로 이태한·이혁 추천)
item.description:
Election Commission Special Counsel Recommendation Committee Recommends Lee Tae-han and Lee Hyuk as Special Counsel Candidates (선관위 특검 추천위, 특검 후보로 이태한·이혁 추천)

The National Recommendation Committee for the 'Special Counsel for the National Election Commission,' tasked with investigating the ballot shortage incident during the June 3 local elections, decided on the 14th to select Lee Hyuk, former prosecutor at the Seoul High Prosecutors' Office, and Lee Tae-han, former head prosecutor at the Seoul Southern District Prosecutors' Office, as special counsel candidates. At its second meeting held at the National Assembly that day, the National Recommendation Committee decided to finalize its recommendation of Lee Hyuk and Lee Tae-han to President Lee Jae-myung from among six candidates proposed by the Korean Bar Association and the Council of Law School Deans. <<> Both Lee Hyuk and Lee Tae-han are 'special investigation veterans' with experience in special investigations at the prosecution service. Lee Hyuk previously worked on the special counsel team investigating the 'corruption allegations surrounding associates of former President Roh Moo-hyun,' while Lee Tae-han served as the head of the special investigation department at the Ulsan District Prosecutors' Office. <<> Earlier, the Korean Bar Association recommended three individuals to the National Recommendation Committee: former prosecutor Lee Hyuk, former head prosecutor Lee Tae-han, and Lee Geum-gyu, a special counsel investigator for the Marine death special counsel. The Council of Law School Deans separately recommended three others: Lim Gwan-hyuk, former chief prosecutor of the Seoul High Prosecutors' Office; Kim Yang-su, former deputy chief prosecutor of the Busan High Prosecutors' Office; and Seo Jeong-sik, former head of the Seongnam Branch Office. The National Recommendation Committee narrowed these down to two and submitted its written recommendation to President Lee. The President will then make the final appointment of one of the two as special counsel. <<> The National Recommendation Committee stated, "We comprehensively reviewed whether the candidates could conduct an independent and fair investigation into the alleged infringement of citizens' political rights, including the ballot shortage incident, and whether they possessed the expertise required to carry out the duties of a special counsel." (6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 등을 수사하기 위한 ‘선거관리위원회 특별검사’ 국민추천위원회가 14일 특검 후보로 이혁 전 서울고검 검사와 이태한 전 서울남부지검 부장검사를 결정했다. 국민추천위는 이날 국회에서 2차 회의를 열고, 대한변호사협회와 법학전문대학원협의회가 추천한 후보 6명 중 이혁·이태한 후보자를 이재명 대통령에게 최종 추천하기로 했다.)

item.title: "Sick and Tired of Prosecution Reform"...74% of Young Party Members Say "The Party Doesn't Listen to Our Voices" (“검찰개혁 지긋지긋”...與 청년당원 74% “당이 우리 목소리 안 들어”)
item.description:
"Sick and Tired of Prosecution Reform"...74% of Young Party Members Say "The Party Doesn't Listen to Our Voices" (“검찰개혁 지긋지긋”...與 청년당원 74% “당이 우리 목소리 안 들어” )

A party-conducted survey taken ahead of the August 17 national convention of the Democratic Party of Korea found that roughly three out of four young paid-up members view the party as one that "does not genuinely listen to the voices of young people." Even as party leadership candidates are touting outreach to the 2030 generation as a key priority in this convention, a large share of young members expressed negative assessments of the party. (더불어민주당이 8·17 전당대회를 치르는 와중에 실시한 당 자체 조사에서 청년 권리당원 4명 중 3명가량이 민주당을 ‘청년의 목소리를 진심으로 듣지 않는 정당’이라고 평가한 것으로 나타났다. 당대표 후보들이 이번 전대에서 2030 청년층 공략을 주요 과제로 내세우고 있는 가운데 정작 청년 당원들에게서 당에 대한 부정적 평가가 대거 나온 것이다.)

According to an online youth perception survey released on the 14th by the youth and future affairs subcommittee of the party's national convention preparation committee, 74% of respondents answered "strongly disagree" or "disagree" to the statement, "The Democratic Party is currently a party that genuinely listens to the voices of young people." (14일 민주당 전당대회준비위원회 청년미래분과가 공개한 온라인 청년 인식 조사에 따르면 ‘지금 민주당은 청년의 목소리를 진심으로 듣는 정당이다’라는 질문에 응답자의 74%가 ‘매우 아니다’ 또는 ‘아니다’라고 답했다.)

Evaluations of internal decision-making and policy were also poor. In response to the questions, "Is this a party where young people can participate in decision-making?" and "Is this a party that understands the lives of young people and reflects them in policy?" 70% respectively gave negative answers. On the assessment, "A party that admits mistakes and changes course," 69% responded negatively, and 60% gave a negative response to the statement, "A party that always follows through on what it promises." (당내 의사 결정과 정책에 대한 평가도 좋지 않았다. ‘청년이 의사결정에 참여할 수 있는 정당인가’, ‘청년의 삶을 이해하고 정책에 반영하는 정당인가’라는 질문에 각각 70%가 부정적으로 답했다. ‘잘못했을 때 인정하고 바꾸는 정당’이라는 평가에는 69%, ‘말한 것은 반드시 실천하는 정당’이라는 평가에는 60%가 부정적 반응을 보였다.)

During the survey, young members submitted a total of 5,670 anonymous suggestions. A member in his 20s from Seoul said, "I'm really sick and tired of prosecution reform," while a member in his 30s from North Jeolla Province said, "Policy isn't just about judicial reform." A member in his 30s from Seoul said, "If you've done something wrong, please just admit it," and a member in his 30s from Gyeonggi Province called for "housing market stability." (조사 과정에서 청년 당원들이 남긴 익명 제안은 5670건에 달했다. 서울의 한 20대 당원은 “검찰개혁 정말 지긋지긋하다”고 했고, 전북의 30대 당원은 “정책이 무슨 사법개혁만 있는 게 아니다”라고 했다. 서울의 30대 당원은 “잘못했으면 제발 인정 좀 하라”고 했고, 경기 지역 30대 당원은 “부동산 안정”을 주문했다.)

Throughout this national convention, party leadership candidates have emphasized the 2030 generation. Candidate Kim Min-seok proposed building a "comprehensive youth platform" centered on the youth committee and college student committee, while Candidate Chung Chung-rae pledged the swift introduction of a 4.5-day workweek as part of his policy on youth employment and labor issues. Candidate Song Young-gil has also pursued young voters by holding 2030 youth meetings during the regional primary tours. (이번 전당대회에서 당대표 후보들은 2030 청년층을 강조해 왔다. 김민석 후보는 청년위원회·대학생위원회를 중심으로 한 ‘청년 종합 플랫폼’ 구성을 제안했고, 정청래 후보는 청년 일자리·노동 문제와 관련해 주 4.5일제의 조속한 도입을 공약했다. 송영길 후보도 순회경선 과정에서 2030 청년 간담회를 갖는 등 청년 표심 공략에 나섰다.)

The Democratic Party is also holding regional town hall meetings with 2030 young members during the convention period. At the main convention event on the 17th, a "final interview for party leader" is scheduled, in which candidates Kim Min-seok, Chung Chung-rae, and Song Young-gil will answer questions prepared by young members. The findings of this perception survey and opinions gathered from the regional town hall meetings will be reflected in the interview questions and in the youth policy agenda for the new leadership. (민주당도 이번 전대 기간 2030 청년 당원들과 권역별 타운홀 미팅을 진행하고 있다. 오는 17일 전당대회 본행사에서는 김민석·정청래·송영길 후보가 청년들이 만든 질문에 답하는 ‘당대표 최종면접’도 예정돼 있다. 이번 인식 조사 결과와 권역별 타운홀 미팅에서 나온 의견도 면접 질문과 새 지도부의 청년 정책 과제에 반영될 예정이다.)

The survey was conducted online over roughly three weeks from the 23rd of last month to the 13th of this month, with 2,380 young paid-up members participating. (이번 조사는 지난달 23일부터 이달 13일까지 약 3주간 온라인으로 진행됐으며 청년 권리당원 2380명이 참여했다.)

item.title: Kim Yong "Hopes for Early Lame-Duck Status of President Chung Chung-rae" (김용 “정청래 대통령 조기 레임덕 바라나”)
item.description:
Kim Yong "Hopes for Early Lame-Duck Status of President Chung Chung-rae" (김용 “정청래 대통령 조기 레임덕 바라나”)

Kim Yong, a candidate for the Supreme Council member of the Democratic Party of Korea, criticized the controversy surrounding Lee Jin-suk, a lawmaker from the People Power Party, over her disparagement of the May 18 Democratization Movement, saying, "They are exploiting the cracks in the Democratic Party to mislead the youth and voters." <<> Candidate Kim held a press conference at the National Assembly in Yeouido, Seoul, on the 14th and said, "The lawmaker's press conference took place right here just a moment ago," adding, "They call May 18 a 'riot.' This is how the remnants of the far-right insurrection are stirring." <<> Candidate Kim said, "This is not the time for the Democratic Party to be doing this," and "This is the time to unite tightly around President Lee Jae-myung. We must surely fulfill the people's mission." He then added, "If you make ordinary member Kim Yong a Supreme Council member of the Democratic Party, I will stand at the forefront and fight with my whole body." <<> Candidate Kim said, "Today's Gallup poll is shocking," and "In the president's approval rating for state affairs, negative responses have surpassed positive ones." He continued, "Party leader candidate Chung Chung-rae says the president's approval rating is falling because the hearts of traditional supporters have cooled, so I am deeply concerned that it is not the People Power Party but Candidate Chung who is hoping for the president's early lame-duck status." <<> He then said, "Are they trying to reorganize the Democratic Party around Chung Chung-rae instead of Lee Jae-myung?" and "What Team Chung Chung-rae wants is not the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration, but for themselves to seize the next power." <<> Regarding the allegations of bullying and sexual harassment surrounding Lee Sung-yoon, a candidate for Supreme Council member, he said, "Party members have not yet heard any explanation," and "Once I become a Supreme Council member, I will push for a party-level fact-finding investigation." <<> In response, Candidate Lee maintains the position that the allegations are "groundless." In a recent Facebook post, he said, "Baseless negative campaigning and spreading false information are no different from Ilbe," and "I will take full legal action against all malicious instigation acts that interfere with the election." He added, "I have already filed a lawsuit, and additional legal proceedings are underway," and "I will surely hold them accountable to the end." <<> With candidates Kim Min-seok and Chung Chung-rae engaged in a fierce competition for the party leadership, attention is also focused on the results of the Supreme Council member election, which selects five members. With two candidates each from the pro-Myung and pro-Chung factions competing, candidates Kim Yong (pro-Myung) and Lee Sung-yoon (pro-Chung) are battling for the final winning spot in fifth place. (김용 더불어민주당 최고위원 후보가 이진숙 국민의힘 의원의 5·18 민주화운동 폄훼 논란에 대해 “그들은 민주당의 균열을 틈타 청년과 유권자들을 호도하고 있다”고 비판했다.)

item.title: U.S. Eighth Army: "UFS Focus on Alliance Modernization... Demonstrating Combat Power Projection on First Island Chain" (미8군 “UFS 중점, 동맹 현대화…제1도련선 전투력 투사 입증”)
item.description:
U.S. Eighth Army: "UFS Focus on Alliance Modernization... Demonstrating Combat Power Projection on First Island Chain" (미8군 “UFS 중점, 동맹 현대화…제1도련선 전투력 투사 입증”)

The U.S. Eighth Army in South Korea has stated that the focus of the upcoming South Korea-U.S. joint exercise "Ulchi Freedom Shield (UFS)," scheduled for August 17-27, will be on "modernizing the ROK-U.S. alliance" and "shaping the Northeast Asian security environment." (주한 미8군이 오는 17∼27일 실시되는 한미 연합 훈련 ‘을지 자유의 방패(UFS)’의 중점을 ‘한미동맹 현대화’와 ‘동북아시아 안보 환경 조성’ 등에 둔다고 밝혔다.)

On August 14, the Eighth Army released a press statement regarding its participation in this year's UFS exercise, stating, "The Eighth Army will focus the exercise on strengthening 'Fight Tonight' capabilities—our standing combat readiness—modernizing the ROK-U.S. alliance, and shaping the Northeast Asian security environment." (미8군은 14일 올해 UFS 훈련 참가와 관련한 보도자료를 내고 “미8군은 상시 전투 태세인 ‘파이트 투나잇’ 역량 강화, 한미동맹 현대화 및 동북아시아 안보 환경 조성에 훈련의 중점을 둔다”고 했다.)

The modernization of the ROK-U.S. alliance is a phrase referring to efforts by South Korea and the United States to strengthen South Korea's self-defense capabilities, pursued under the Trump administration's emphasis on burden-sharing within the alliance. It also encompasses the concept of strategic flexibility for U.S. Forces Korea, which extends beyond the Korean Peninsula to considerations such as a Taiwan contingency. (한미동맹 현대화는 동맹의 부담 분담을 강조하는 트럼프 정부 기조하에 한·미가 추진하는 한국의 자체 방위력 강화 등을 뜻하는 표현이다. 한반도 범위를 넘어 대만 유사시 상황 등을 염두에 둔 주한미군의 전략적 유연성도 포함하는 개념이다.)

The Eighth Army also stated, "Establishing theater logistics and sustainment systems remains our top priority," and "This exercise includes rapid distribution and preparation procedures for Army Prepositioned Stocks-4 (APS-4), demonstrating the alliance's ability to rapidly project combat power and secure key terrain within the First Island Chain." (미8군은 또 “전구 내 군수 및 지속지원 체계를 확립하는 것은 여전히 미8군의 최우선 과제”라며 “이번 연습에는 육군 사전배치물자4(APS-4)의 신속한 분배 및 준비 절차가 포함돼 있어, 제1도련선 내에서 전투력을 신속하게 투사하고 핵심 지형을 확보할 수 있는 동맹의 능력을 입증하게 된다”고 했다.)

"Deterrence by denial"—making it difficult for China to achieve military objectives within the First Island Chain connecting Japan's Okinawa, Taiwan, and the Philippines—is a military strategy promoted by the Trump administration for the Indo-Pacific region. (일본 오키나와와 대만, 필리핀 등을 잇는 제1도련선 내에서 중국이 군사적 목표를 달성하기 어렵게 만드는 ‘거부에 의한 억제’는 트럼프 행정부의 인도·태평양 지역에서 추진하는 군사 전략이다.)

U.S. Army prepositioned stocks involve pre-positioning tanks, armored vehicles, self-propelled artillery, trucks, ammunition, fuel, and other warfighting supplies in major expected conflict areas, reducing deployment time for incoming forces and speeding up response times. In South Korea, Camp Carroll, a U.S. military base in Chilgok, North Gyeongsang Province, is known as the APS-4 site. (미군의 사전배치물자는 주요 예상 분쟁 지역에 전차, 장갑차, 자주포, 트럭, 탄약, 유류 등 전쟁 수행에 필요한 물자를 미리 배치해 놓는 것으로 투입 병력의 전개 시간을 단축하고 대응 속도를 줄일 수 있다. 한국은 경북 칠곡 소재 주한미군 기지 캠프 캐럴이 배치지(APS-4)로 알려졌다.)

Linking the rapid distribution and preparation of prepositioned stocks to combat power projection "within the First Island Chain" can be interpreted as emphasizing South Korea's role not just on the Korean battlefield, but as a logistics hub within the Indo-Pacific region. (사전배치물자의 신속한 분배·준비를 ‘제1도련선 내’ 전투력 투사와 연결 지은 언급은 비단 한반도 전장이 아니라 인태 지역 내 군수 거점으로서 한국의 역할을 강조한 것으로도 해석할 수 있다.)

The Eighth Army also stated that key UFS exercise activities include combined combined-arms live-fire exercises, combined river-crossing exercises, and military police detainee operations. Air defense units will conduct the Indirect Fire Protection Capability (IFPC) exercise "Dragon Flag" at Kunsan Air Base. (이번 UFS 주요 훈련 내용에는 연합 제병 협동 실사격 훈련, 연합 도하 훈련, 군사경찰 부대의 억류자 작전 등이 포함된다고 미8군은 밝혔다. 방공 부대들은 군산 공군기지에서 간접화력방어역량(IFPC) 훈련인 ‘드래곤 플래그’를 실시할 예정이다.)

item.title: Cheon Ha-ram, '40s Trainee': "I Thought I Was Going to Die... The Sacrifice of Our Soldiers Is Truly Remarkable" (‘40대 훈련병’ 천하람 “정말 죽는 줄...국군 장병 노고 대단”)
item.description:
Cheon Ha-ram, '40s Trainee': "I Thought I Was Going to Die... The Sacrifice of Our Soldiers Is Truly Remarkable" (‘40대 훈련병’ 천하람 “정말 죽는 줄...국군 장병 노고 대단”)

Cheon Ha-ram, the floor leader of the Reform Party, who experienced a three-day, two-night basic training at the Army Training Center in Nonsan, South Chungcheong Province starting on the 12th, said on the 14th, "During the training, I really thought I was going to die," adding, "For me, it was just a brief moment, but the dedication of our soldiers defending the nation is truly remarkable." (지난 12일부터 충남 논산 육군훈련소에서 2박3일간 신병 교육을 체험한 천하람 개혁신당 원내대표가 14일 “훈련받을 때는 정말 죽는 줄 알았다”며 “저야 잠깐이고, 나라를 지키는 우리 국군 장병의 노고가 정말 대단하다”고 했다.)

Floor leader Cheon was assigned to the National Defense Committee for the second half of the 22nd National Assembly. Before entering the training center on the 12th, he had said, "I will personally experience the treatment and living conditions of our soldiers who quietly carry out their duties even in the scorching heat, and reflect that in future National Defense Committee activities and policy inquiries." This marks the first time an incumbent lawmaker has entered the Nonsan Army Training Center as a trainee. (천 원내대표는 22대 후반기 국회에서 국방위원회에 배치됐다. 지난 12일 입소에 앞서 “폭염 속에서도 나라를 위해 묵묵히 임무를 수행하는 국군 장병들의 처우와 생활 환경을 몸으로 겪어보고 향후 국방위 활동과 정책 질의에 반영할 것”이라고 했었다. 현역 국회의원이 논산 육군훈련소에 훈련병으로 입소한 것은 처음이다.)

On that day, Floor leader Cheon said on Facebook, "The training was tough, but wearing military uniforms and living collectively in this heat was no joke." He added, "Waking up at 3 a.m. and immediately focusing intensely on core tactical training like individual combat was impressive. During the hottest part of the day, they prevented heat-related illnesses with afternoon naps and personal maintenance, and the heat-response equipment and medical systems were fully operational, ensuring both safety and training outcomes." He continued, "Despite the heat and hardship, the camaraderie of helping each other was truly touching. Our young generation in their 20s is carrying out their assigned roles more diligently and faithfully than anyone. I respect all our soldiers." (천 원내대표는 이날 페이스북에서 “훈련도 힘들었지만 이 더위에 군복 입고 단체 생활하는 것 자체가 장난이 아니었다”고 했다. 그는 “새벽 3시에 기상해 곧바로 각개전투 등 핵심 전술 훈련에 고강도로 집중하는 모습이 인상적이었다”며 “가장 뜨거운 낮 시간대에는 오침과 개인정비로 온열 질환을 예방하되, 폭염 대응 장비와 의료 체계가 충실히 가동돼 안전과 훈련 성과를 모두 챙기고 있었다”고 했다. 이어 “덥고 힘든 상황에서도 서로 돕는 전우애를 발휘해 정말 뭉클했다”며 “우리 20대 젊은 세대는 누구보다 착실하고 충실하게 맡겨진 역할을 잘 수행하고 있다. 모든 장병 여러분 존경스럽다”고 했다.)

Floor leader Cheon also said, "Training schedules, assembly times, and physical fitness test results were guided and recorded via smartwatches," adding, "With the excessive paperwork and the burden of relaying and disseminating information gone, both officers and drill instructors were highly satisfied, and the trainees' satisfaction was also very high." He went on, "From what I felt, having air conditioning in all the barracks at the training center is a truly welcome change. The training center cafeteria is also operated by professional contractors rather than cooks from the ranks. The food was good, and trainee satisfaction was high." He added, "Some training battalions haven't yet introduced smartwatches, but they're expected to do so soon. I'll also make sure the budget comes through properly." (천 원내대표는 또 “훈련 일정·집합 시간·체력 측정 결과 등이 스마트워치로 안내·기록되고 있었다”며 “과도한 서류 작업과 전달, 전파 부담이 사라져서 간부와 조교의 만족도도 높고 훈련병들의 만족도도 매우 높았다”고 했다. 이어 “체감으로는 훈련소 모든 생활관에 에어컨이 있는 것이 정말 바람직한 변화로 느껴졌다”며 “훈련소 식당도 취사병이 아닌 전문 업체가 위탁 운영한다. 맛도 좋고 훈련병들 만족도도 높았다”고 했다. 그러면서 “아직 스마트워치 도입이 안 된 교육 연대도 일부 있었는데, 곧 도입 예정이라고 한다”며 “예산이 무사히 나오는지 저도 챙기겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: South Korean PM Discusses SMRs with Bill Gates... Gates: "Korea's Nuclear Capabilities Will Contribute to the SMR Ecosystem" (韓총리·빌 게이츠 SMR 논의… 게이츠 “한국 원전 역량, SMR 생태계 기여할 것”)
item.description:
South Korean PM Discusses SMRs with Bill Gates... Gates: "Korea's Nuclear Capabilities Will Contribute to the SMR Ecosystem" (韓총리·빌 게이츠 SMR 논의… 게이츠 “한국 원전 역량, SMR 생태계 기여할 것”)

Prime Minister Han Duck-soo met with Bill Gates, co-founder of Microsoft and founder of next-generation nuclear company TerraPower, on the 14th to discuss cooperation on small modular reactors (SMRs). (한성숙 국무총리가 마이크로소프트 공동 창업자이자 차세대 원전 기업 테라파워 창업자인 빌 게이츠 게이츠재단 이사장을 14일 만나 소형 모듈형 원자로(SMR) 관련 협력 방안을 논의했다.)

According to the Office of the Prime Minister, PM Han met with Chairman Gates, who arrived in South Korea the previous day, at the government complex in Seoul for approximately 30 minutes of conversation. (국무총리실에 따르면, 한 총리는 전날 방한한 게이츠 이사장을 이날 오후 정부서울청사에서 만나 30분가량 대화했다.)

PM Han said, "Korea is pursuing three mega projects in response to the era of AI (artificial intelligence) transformation," adding, "A stable power supply is crucial to support these efforts." She also noted, "We are exploring an 'energy mix' (combining various energy sources) that utilizes renewables and SMRs." (한 총리는 “한국이 AI(인공지능) 대전환 시대를 맞이해 3대 메가 프로젝트를 추진하고 있다”고 소개하면서 “이를 뒷받침하기 위해 전력 공급이 매우 중요하다”고 했다. 그러면서 “재생에너지와 SMR을 활용하는 ‘에너지 믹스’(다양한 에너지원을 조합하는 것)를 모색하고 있다”고 했다.)

PM Han continued, "I highly value the cooperation between TerraPower and Korean companies and research institutions in the next-generation SMR field, spanning the entire cycle from investment to manufacturing and construction." (한 총리는 이어 “차세대 SMR 분야에서 테라파워와 한국 기업, 연구 기관이 투자부터 제작, 건설에 이르기까지 전 주기에 걸쳐 협력하고 있는 점을 높이 평가한다”고 했다.)

Chairman Gates responded, "I resonate with the Korean government's efforts to respond to the shift in the energy paradigm." (게이츠 이사장은 “에너지 패러다임 변화에 대응하기 위한 한국 정부의 노력에 공감한다”고 화답했다.)

Chairman Gates further said, "Korea has experience accumulated through the construction and operation of nuclear power plants, along with the capability to execute challenging large-scale projects, which will greatly contribute to achieving global carbon neutrality and building an innovative SMR ecosystem in the future." He added, "I will further strengthen strategic partnerships with Korean companies." (게이츠 이사장은 이어 “한국은 원전 건설과 운영을 통해 쌓아 온 경험과 어려운 대형 사업을 구현해 내는 역량이 있어, 향후 글로벌 탄소 중립 달성과 혁신 SMR 생태계 조성에 크게 기여할 것”이라며 “한국 기업과의 전략적 파트너십을 한층 강화해 나가겠다”고 했다.)

It was reported that Chairman Gates explained in detail to PM Han how critical the role of SMRs is in addressing climate change. (게이츠 이사장은 한 총리에게 기후 변화에 대응하는 데서 SMR의 역할이 얼마나 중요한지를 상세히 설명한 것으로 전해졌다.)

TerraPower, founded by Chairman Gates in 2008, has developed a reactor that uses liquid sodium as a coolant instead of water, and in March received approval from the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) to build commercial SMRs using this reactor design. (게이츠 이사장이 2008년 창업한 테라파워는 냉각재로 물이 아닌 액체 나트륨을 사용하는 원자로를 개발했고, 지난 3월 미국 원자력규제위원회(NRC)로부터 이 노형으로 상업용 SMR을 건설해도 된다는 허가를 받았다.)

The Office of the Prime Minister stated, "The government has established the legal foundation for fostering the SMR industry through the enactment of the Special Act on SMRs," and "We plan to improve the regulatory framework centered on large-scale reactors to encompass SMRs, support the development of various SMR types, and actively back the early commercialization of SMRs." (총리실은 “정부는 SMR 특별법 제정을 통해 SMR 산업 육성의 법적 기반을 마련했다”며 “대형 원전 중심의 규제 체계를 SMR까지 포괄할 수 있도록 개선하고, 다양한 SMR 유형 개발을 지원해 SMR의 조기 상용화를 적극 뒷받침할 계획”이라고 밝혔다.)

item.title: "Delaying Investment in the US Will Lead to Tariff Hikes"... US Sends Letter to Korea as a Final Ultimatum (“대미투자 늦어지면 관세 인상”... 美, 한국에 서한 보내 최후통첩)
item.description:
"Delaying Investment in the US Will Lead to Tariff Hikes"... US Sends Letter to Korea as a Final Ultimatum (“대미투자 늦어지면 관세 인상”... 美, 한국에 서한 보내 최후통첩)

The US government has reportedly pressured the Korean government, warning that it would raise tariffs if Seoul does not expedite its investment in the US. In response, Cheong Wa Dae held an emergency meeting on the 13th with relevant ministries to discuss countermeasures. Last month, the US imposed a 12.5% tariff on Korea under Section 301 of the Trade Act (Super 301). However, further procedures remain, meaning the rate could exceed 15%. (미국 정부가 최근 우리 정부에 “대미 투자를 서두르지 않으면 관세를 올리겠다”고 압박한 것으로 알려졌다. 이에 청와대가 지난 13일 관계부처가 참여하는 긴급회의를 열어 대응책을 논의했다. 미국은 지난달 무역법 301조(슈퍼 301조)에 따라 한국에 12.5% 관세를 부과했다. 다만 추가적인 과정이 남아 있어 15%가 넘을 수도 있다.)

According to relevant ministries on the 14th, the US Department of Commerce recently expressed strong discontent to the Korean government over the failure to execute, for the past 10 months, the $200 billion investment in the US (excluding $150 billion in shipbuilding cooperation) promised in the Korea-US Joint Fact Sheet (JFS), a result of the October summit in Gyeongju. In response, Cheong Wa Dae convened officials from the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and other related agencies the previous day for a meeting. At the time of the JFS signing, Korea received a reciprocal tariff rate of 15% on the premise of investments in the US. However, the US federal court nullified this, and the US administration set new tariffs under Super 301. (14일 관계부처에 따르면 미 상무부는 지난해 10월 경주 한·미 정상회담 결과물인 ‘한·미 조인트팩트시트(JFS)’에서 약속한 2000억달러 규모 대미 투자(조선업 협력 1500억달러 제외)를 10개월째 집행하지 않고 있다는 불만을 최근 우리 정부에 강도높게 피력했다고 한다. 이에 청와대는 전날 산업통상부 등 관련 부처 관계자를 소집해 회의를 가졌다. JFS 체결 당시 한국은 대미투자를 전제로 상호관세 15%를 적용 받았다. 다만 미 연방법원이 이를 무효화했고, 미 행정부는 슈퍼 301조에 의거해 새롭게 관세를 책정했다.)

Cheong Wa Dae said in a notice that day, "Discussions on strategic investment projects between Korea and the US are being conducted closely through various channels, and the government is responding to US trade issues through frequent, close communication internally." While a visit to the US by Trade Minister Kim Jung-kwan is being mentioned in some circles, Cheong Wa Dae stated, "No plan for the trade minister's visit to the US has been confirmed at this time." The JFS stipulates that Korea will "pursue" investments totaling $350 billion — $150 billion in shipbuilding cooperation and $200 billion in strategic investment — by the end of President Donald Trump's term (January 2029). (청와대는 이날 공지를 통해 “한미간 전략 투자 프로젝트와 관련해 다양한 채널을 통해 긴밀히 논의가 진행 중이며, 대미 통상현안과 관련해 정부 내에서도 수시로 긴밀히 소통하면서 대응 중”이라고 했다. 김정관 산업통상부 장관의 방미도 일각에서 거론되지만 청와대는 “산업부 장관의 방미 계획은 현재로서 정해진 바 없다”고 했다. JFS에는 한국이 도널드 트럼프 대통령 임기 종료(2029년 1월)까지 조선업 협력 1500억달러와 전략투자 2000억달러 총 3500억달러 투자를 ‘추진’한다고 명시돼 있다.)

The US discontent stems from the fact that Japan announced its first (February) and second (March) investment projects in quick succession early this year, while Korea has yet to unveil its first investment project in the US. However, given that Korea concluded tariff negotiations three months later than Japan and is currently finalizing a $20 billion gas-fired combined-cycle power plant project in Texas as its first project, the US complaints are being viewed as a "whip" to spur action. A government official said, "This appears to be influenced by the US midterm elections in November," adding, "The selection of the first project is proceeding without any setbacks." (미국의 불만은 일본이 올해 초 1호(2월)·2호(3월) 투자 프로젝트를 연달아 발표한 데 비해, 한국은 아직 대미 투자 1호 프로젝트를 발표하지 않는다는 점이다. 다만 우리가 일본보다 관세협상 타결 시점이 3개월 늦었고, 최근 200억달러 규모의 미국 텍사스주 가스복합화력발전단지 건설을 1호 프로젝트로 구체화하고 있기 때문에 이 같은 미국의 불만을 ‘채찍질’로 받아들이는 분위기다. 정부 관계자는 “11월 미국이 중간선거를 앞둔 영향으로 보인다”며 “1호 프로젝트 선정은 차질 없이 진행중”이라고 했다.)

On the 23rd of last month (local time), the US announced it would impose tariffs of 10–12.5% on 60 countries that have not introduced or enforced measures banning the import of goods produced with "forced labor" under Super 301. A 12.5% tariff was applied to Korea. This came after the global tariffs initially imposed by the Trump administration were ruled unlawful by the US Supreme Court, leading the US administration to set new tariffs. The 12.5% applied to Korea is not the final rate. Last month, Cheong Wa Dae National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac said at a press briefing that "additional tariffs could be added." (미국은 지난달 23일(현지시각) 슈퍼 301조에 따라 ‘강제 노동’으로 생산된 상품의 수입 금지 조치를 도입·시행하지 않은 60개국에 10~12.5%의 관세를 부과한다고 밝혔다. 한국에는 12.5%의 관세를 적용했다. 당초 트럼프 행정부가 부과했던 글로벌 관세가 미국 연방대법원에서 위법으로 판결나면서 새로 관세를 메긴 것이다. 우리에게 적용된 12.5%가 최종적인 세율은아니다. 지난달 위성락 청와대 국가안보실장은 기자브리핑에서 “추가적인 관세가 붙을 수 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee "Open to Shortening Term for Constitutional Amendment on 4-Year Two-Term or Re-election" (李 “4년 중임 또는 연임 개헌 위해 임기 단축도 수용”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 14th on X (formerly Twitter), "My official position during the 2022 presidential election was to change the presidential term to a four-year two-term or four-year re-election system to enable accountable politics through mid-term evaluations, and if shortening the presidential term is necessary for a constitutional amendment, I can accept it. That thinking remains unchanged." This is the first time President Lee has publicly mentioned shortening his own term since taking office. (이재명 대통령은 14일 X(옛 트위터)에 “대통령 임기는 4년 중임 또는 4년 연임제로 변경해 중간 평가를 통한 책임정치가 가능하도록 하며, 개헌을 위해 대통령 임기 단축이 필요하다면 이를 수용할 수 있다는 것이 2022년 대선 당시 저의 공식 입장이었고, 그 생각은 지금도 변함이 없다”고 밝혔다. 이 대통령이 자신의 임기 단축을 공개적으로 언급한 것은 취임 후 처음이다.)

President Lee's remarks on constitutional reform came amid growing controversy after Kim Tae-ho, a lawmaker from the People Power Party who played golf with the president last month, said the previous day that "President Lee mentioned a power-sharing constitutional amendment and said shortening his term is possible." In response, the opposition party pushed back, saying, "The president is using tricks to extend his term through a power-sharing presidential system with a cabinet system in mind." In connection with this, President Lee said the same day, "A dual executive system or cabinet system is neither desirable nor feasible in light of public opinion," adding, "It is a misunderstanding to say that power-sharing presidential system or cabinet system means dispersing some presidential authority to the National Assembly." However, President Lee again did not make the statement demanded by the People Power Party that he "will not seek re-election." <<> President Lee had campaigned on a constitutional amendment including a four-year re-election system as a key pledge and his "first state task," but after taking office, he has maintained that constitutional reform should proceed step by step, starting with items agreed upon by both ruling and opposition parties, even if only through a "one-point" amendment. On this day, however, he mentioned for the first time since his inauguration a four-year two-term or re-election system. Under a re-election system, a sitting president can serve up to eight consecutive years only if re-elected immediately after their term ends, whereas under a two-term system, a sitting president can run once more and be elected regardless of consecutive election status. President Lee had advocated for a four-year re-election system during the 2025 presidential election. <<> Meanwhile, a Gallup Korea poll released the same day showed President Lee's approval rating at 44%, the lowest on record. This figure is lower than his 44.42% vote share in the presidential election, and by Gallup's standards, it marks the first "dead cross" since his inauguration, with negative evaluations (46%) surpassing positive ones. (이 대통령의 개헌 발언은 지난달 대통령과 골프 라운딩을 한 김태호 국민의힘 의원이 전날 “이 대통령이 분권형 개헌을 언급하며 임기 단축도 가능하다고 말했다”고 밝혀 논란이 커지자 나온 것이다. 이를 두고 야당은 “대통령이 내각제 등을 염두에 둔 분권형 대통령제를 통해 임기 연장을 하려고 꼼수를 쓰는 것”이라고 반발했다. 이와 관련해 이 대통령은 이날 “이원집정제나 내각제는 바람직하지도 않고 국민 여론에 비춰 가능하지도 않다”라며 “대통령 권한을 국회 등으로 일부 분산하자는 것이 분권형 대통령제나 내각제라는 것은 잘못된 이해”라고 했다. 하지만 이 대통령은 국민의힘이 요구하고 있는 ‘연임하지 않겠다’는 발언은 이날도 하지 않았다.)

item.title: U.S. Pressures South Korea: "Delayed Investment in U.S. Will Lead to Higher Tariffs" (美 “대미투자 늦어지면 관세 인상” 압박)
item.description:
The U.S. government has reportedly pressured the South Korean government, saying, "If you don't expedite investment in the U.S., we will raise tariffs." In response, the presidential office held an emergency meeting on the 13th with relevant ministries to discuss countermeasures. The U.S. imposed a 12.5% tariff on South Korea last month under Section 301 of the Trade Act (Super 301). However, additional procedures remain, which could push the rate above 15%. (미국 정부가 최근 우리 정부에 “대미 투자를 서두르지 않으면 관세를 올리겠다”고 압박한 것으로 알려졌다. 이에 청와대가 지난 13일 관계부처가 참여하는 긴급회의를 열어 대응책을 논의했다. 미국은 지난달 무역법 301조(슈퍼 301조)에 따라 한국에 12.5% 관세를 부과했다. 다만 추가적인 과정이 남아 있어 15%가 넘을 수도 있다.)

According to relevant ministries on the 14th, the U.S. Department of Commerce recently expressed strong dissatisfaction to the South Korean government that the $200 billion investment in the U.S. (excluding $150 billion in shipbuilding cooperation) promised in the "Korea-U.S. Joint Fact Sheet (JFS)"—an outcome of the Gyeongju Korea-U.S. summit held last October—has not been carried out for 10 months. In response, the presidential office convened a meeting on the previous day with officials from the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and other related agencies. At the time of the JFS signing, South Korea received a 15% reciprocal tariff on the premise of investment in the U.S. However, the U.S. federal court nullified that measure, and the U.S. administration newly set tariffs under Super 301. (14일 관계부처에 따르면 미 상무부는 지난해 10월 경주 한·미 정상회담 결과물인 ‘한·미 조인트팩트시트(JFS)’에서 약속한 2000억달러 규모 대미 투자(조선업 협력 1500억달러 제외)를 10개월째 집행하지 않고 있다는 불만을 최근 우리 정부에 강도높게 피력했다고 한다. 이에 청와대는 전날 산업통상부 등 관련 부처 관계자를 소집해 회의를 가졌다. JFS 체결 당시 한국은 대미투자를 전제로 상호관세 15%를 적용 받았다. 다만 미 연방법원이 이를 무효화했고, 미 행정부는 슈퍼 301조에 의거해 새롭게 관세를 책정했다.)

◇ U.S. Commerce Department Pours Out Complaints to South Korean Government: "Why No Results in 10 Months on U.S. Investment?" (◇美상무부 “대미투자 왜 10개월째 성과 없나” 한국 정부에 불만 쏟아내)

The presidential office said in a notice that day, "Discussions on the Korea-U.S. strategic investment projects are being held closely through various channels, and the government is responding by communicating frequently and closely on trade issues with the U.S." Some have floated the idea of Trade Minister Kim Jung-kwan visiting the U.S., but the presidential office said, "There are currently no confirmed plans for the trade minister's visit to the U.S." The JFS states that South Korea will "pursue" investments totaling $350 billion by the end of President Donald Trump's term (January 2029), including $150 billion in shipbuilding cooperation and $200 billion in strategic investment. (청와대는 이날 공지를 통해 “한미간 전략 투자 프로젝트와 관련해 다양한 채널을 통해 긴밀히 논의가 진행 중이며, 대미 통상현안과 관련해 정부 내에서도 수시로 긴밀히 소통하면서 대응 중”이라고 했다. 김정관 산업통상부 장관의 방미도 일각에서 거론되지만 청와대는 “산업부 장관의 방미 계획은 현재로서 정해진 바 없다”고 했다. JFS에는 한국이 도널드 트럼프 대통령 임기 종료(2029년 1월)까지 조선업 협력 1500억달러와 전략투자 2000억달러 총 3500억달러 투자를 ‘추진’한다고 명시돼 있다.)

The U.S. complaint stems from the fact that Japan announced its first (February) and second (March) investment projects in succession early this year, while South Korea has yet to announce its first U.S. investment project. However, since South Korea reached its tariff negotiation conclusion three months later than Japan and is currently finalizing a $20 billion gas combined-cycle power plant project in Texas as its first project, the U.S. dissatisfaction is being viewed as a "whip" to spur action. A government official said, "It appears to be influenced by the U.S. midterm elections in November," adding, "The selection of the first project is proceeding without disruption." (미국의 불만은 일본이 올해 초 1호(2월)·2호(3월) 투자 프로젝트를 연달아 발표한 데 비해, 한국은 아직 대미 투자 1호 프로젝트를 발표하지 않는다는 점이다. 다만 우리가 일본보다 관세협상 타결 시점이 3개월 늦었고, 최근 200억달러 규모의 미국 텍사스주 가스복합화력발전단지 건설을 1호 프로젝트로 구체화하고 있기 때문에 이 같은 미국의 불만을 ‘채찍질’로 받아들이는 분위기다. 정부 관계자는 “11월 미국이 중간선거를 앞둔 영향으로 보인다”며 “1호 프로젝트 선정은 차질 없이 진행중”이라고 했다.)

On the 23rd of last month (local time), the U.S. announced that it would impose tariffs of 10% to 12.5% on 60 countries that have not introduced or enforced measures to ban imports of goods produced through "forced labor" under Super 301. South Korea was subject to a 12.5% tariff. This came after the global tariffs originally imposed by the Trump administration were ruled illegal by the U.S. Supreme Court, leading to the new tariff assessment. The 12.5% applied to South Korea is not the final rate. Last month, Wi Sung-lac, the presidential office's national security director, said in a press briefing, "Additional tariffs could be added." (미국은 지난달 23일(현지시각) 슈퍼 301조에 따라 ‘강제 노동’으로 생산된 상품의 수입 금지 조치를 도입·시행하지 않은 60개국에 10~12.5%의 관세를 부과한다고 밝혔다. 한국에는 12.5%의 관세를 적용했다. 당초 트럼프 행정부가 부과했던 글로벌 관세가 미국 연방대법원에서 위법으로 판결나면서 새로 관세를 메긴 것이다. 우리에게 적용된 12.5%가 최종적인 세율은아니다. 지난달 위성락 청와대 국가안보실장은 기자브리핑에서 “추가적인 관세가 붙을 수 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: On mention of 'two-term or re-election constitutional amendment'... People Power Party: "Is Lee saying he'll step down and then come back?" (‘중임 또는 연임 개헌’ 언급에… 국힘 “李, 물러났다가 다시 하겠다는 건가”)
item.description:
The People Power Party on the 14th pushed back against President Lee Jae-myung personally mentioning a "four-year two-term presidency system," calling it "a trick for long-term power" and "a distraction following a plunge in approval ratings." (국민의힘은 14일 이재명 대통령이 직접 나서서 ‘4년 중임 대통령제’를 언급한 데 대해 “장기 집권을 위한 꼼수” “지지율 급락에 따른 시선 돌리기”라며 반발했다.)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said on Facebook that day, "As I've said repeatedly, the prerequisite for a constitutional amendment is simple," adding, "It's declaring, 'I'll only serve one term as president.'" He then said, "Put aside your vain ambitions and tend to the livelihood ministries." <<> Floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik also said, "The essence is one thing. This is an attempt at a 'prison-break constitutional amendment,' where the president tries to break through his legal risks with a constitutional change. If there's even a fingernail's worth of sincerity about constitutional reform, he should come before the people and first promise 'no re-election' and 'I'll stand trial immediately.'" Lawmaker Joo Jin-woo called it "a trick to hold onto power for the long term." <<> The opposition suspects the president, facing record-low approval ratings, has turned to a constitutional amendment to shift the political landscape. Former lawmaker Yoo Seong-min said, "Today, when the Gallup poll showed negative ratings surpassing positive ratings for the first time, the president and the presidential office talked about constitutional reform. The public thinks: 'A president who should stand trial after his term is trying to extend his term or eliminate his trial by any means — bringing up constitutional amendments and attempting to withdraw indictments.'" Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon also called it "PR spin to divert attention amid a ratings crash." <<> Within the opposition, questions also arose about the fact that while President Lee's campaign pledge was a "four-year re-election system," the presidential office mentioned a "four-year two-term system" that day. People Power Party lawmaker Yoo Sang-beom, citing the constitutional provision that a constitutional amendment does not apply to the president in office at the time of the amendment, said, "A re-election constitutional amendment would have no effect on the president, but if a two-term system is combined with a shortened term, it could open the door for him to step down and then run again under the new constitution. It looks like nothing more than a scheme to step away from the presidency once and then come back." (국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 이날 페이스북에서 “거듭 말하지만 개헌의 전제 조건은 간단하다”며 “‘대통령 한 번만 하겠다’고 선언하는 것”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “허망한 욕심 그만 내려놓고 민생부처 챙기시기 바란다”고 했다.)

item.title: "Constitutional Amendment Discussion Should Be the National Assembly's" - Lee Passes the Ball, but Ruling and Opposition Parties Remain at Loggerheads (“개헌 논의는 국회가” 李는 공 넘겼지만 여야는 계속 대치중)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 14th via X (formerly Twitter), "If we are to actually amend the Constitution, it is desirable that the specific details be decided in the National Assembly through agreement between the ruling and opposition parties," emphasizing that the constitutional amendment discussion should be entirely left to the National Assembly. The presidential office's position is that "rather than the government drafting its own amendment proposal, it is appropriate for the National Assembly to handle it." However, after Jo Jeong-sik, a key figure in the pro-Lee faction and National Assembly Speaker, said at his inaugural press conference last month that "a two-term presidency for a sitting president is a matter of the people's choice," seemingly leaving the door open for such a possibility, the People Power Party has stated it "cannot engage in constitutional amendment discussions," casting a shadow over future negotiations between the ruling and opposition parties. <<> A presidential office official also told reporters that day, "Since a constitutional amendment requires the consent of 200 or more lawmakers in the National Assembly, it is desirable for it to be discussed and pursued in the National Assembly." This implies that it would be difficult with the current number of seats held by the Democratic Party and that cooperation from the People Power Party is necessary. Constitutional amendment is the "top national agenda item" of the Lee Jae-myung administration. It was also one of President Lee's campaign pledges, and early in his term, the State Affairs Planning Committee released a draft amendment that included provisions for a four-year two-term presidency and a runoff voting system. <<> Subsequently, at a cabinet meeting in May, President Lee stated, "Undertaking a full-scale constitutional amendment all at once carries a heavy burden. It is necessary to take a pragmatic approach," expressing his position to push for sequential amendments, starting with issues that can be agreed upon by both ruling and opposition parties, such as strengthening the requirements for declaring martial law and incorporating the spirit of the May 18 Democratization Movement into the preamble of the Constitution. At the time, former National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik attempted to push forward this "one-point" amendment proposal but failed to secure bipartisan agreement. <<> Speaker Jo Jeong-sik plans to establish a Constitutional Amendment Advisory Committee directly under the National Assembly Speaker immediately after the regular session opens in September, and to form a special committee on constitutional amendment within the Assembly, aiming to finalize an amendment proposal after full-fledged discussions next year. The goal is to hold a national referendum on the amendment during the April 2028 general elections for the 23rd National Assembly. Speaker Jo also holds the position that proposals to amend the structure of government power, such as introducing a four-year two-term presidential system, should be included in the amendment. An official from the Speaker's office said, "No specific timeline or procedure has been decided yet," adding, "It will be settled based on future consultations between the ruling and opposition parties." <<> However, the People Power Party maintains that while a constitutional amendment is necessary, "discussions can only begin if the president explicitly rules out the possibility of a second term." Earlier, Speaker Jo sparked controversy on the 28th of last month at his first press briefing after taking office with remarks that seemed to hint at the possibility of amending the Constitution to allow a sitting president's re-election. Although presidential office aides later sought to clarify, saying, "President Lee has stated that a second term for a sitting president is impossible," the People Power Party has not let go of its suspicion that the constitutional amendment discussion is effectively an attempt to extend power. (이재명 대통령은 14일 X를 통해 “실제 개헌한다면 그 구체적 내용은 여야 합의로 국회에서 정하는 것이 바람직하다”며 개헌 논의는 전적으로 국회에 맡겨야 한다고 했다. 청와대는 “정부의 개헌안을 만들기 보다는 국회에서 하는 게 맞다”는 입장이다. 하지만 친명계 핵심인 조정식 국회의장이 지난달 취임 기자회견에서 “현직 대통령 연임은 국민 선택의 문제”라며 연임 가능성을 열어놓는 듯한 발언을 한 뒤 국민의힘이 “개헌 논의에 임할 수 없다”고 하면서 향후 여야 간 개헌 논의는 난항을 겪을 전망이다.)

item.title: All People Power Party lawmakers who received President Lee's golf invitation were constitutional amendment advocates (李대통령 골프 제안받은 국힘 의원들, 모두 개헌론자였다)
item.description:
Various interpretations are emerging regarding President Lee Jae-myung's recent golf outings with People Power Party lawmakers, during which conversations about constitutional amendment took place. Coincidentally, most of the People Power Party lawmakers who played golf with President Lee or received invitations were members of the party's constitutional amendment special committee. In the opposition camp, speculation arose that the President's golf meetings were intended from the outset with "implementing constitutional reform" in mind. Since a constitutional amendment bill requires "approval by two-thirds or more of all sitting lawmakers" to pass the National Assembly, at least 10 of the 109 People Power Party lawmakers would need to vote in favor. The claim is that President Lee, who has made constitutional amendment his "top national priority," has been directly persuading opposition lawmakers through these golf meetings. <<> Within the People Power Party, lawmakers such as Joo Ho-young, Park Deok-heum, Kim Tae-ho, and Shin Seong-beom have either played golf with President Lee or received invitations to do so. Additionally, it was confirmed on the 14th that lawmaker Choi Hyeong-doo also received a golf meeting invitation. Choi reportedly did not play golf with the President due to a scheduling conflict. All of them are advocates of constitutional amendment. <<> Lawmaker Joo Ho-young, about a month after the martial law crisis two years ago, argued for constitutional amendment, stating that "the imperial presidency created by the 1987 system has proven to be past its expiration date." After the People Power Party transitioned to an emergency steering committee system, Joo took on the role of chair of the constitutional amendment special committee. At the time, there were five incumbent lawmakers on the special committee, and Shin Seong-beom and Choi Hyeong-doo were among them. <<> In June, President Lee played golf with Joo Ho-young, who was then the first deputy speaker of the National Assembly, Park Deok-heum, who assumed the role of second deputy speaker, and National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik, a former Democratic Party member. It is known that Joo was the first to receive the presidential invitation during that meeting. An opposition figure said, "I understand that when Joo first received the President's golf invitation, he declined, but after repeated offers, he proposed a format where the President would play together with the Assembly leadership," adding, "Although the format was a golf meeting with the Assembly leadership, the person the President most wanted to meet was Joo." <<> Lawmaker Kim Tae-ho, who stated that he proposed a "power-sharing constitutional amendment" while playing golf with President Lee this time, is also a staunch advocate of constitutional amendment, having made "constitutional amendment to end the '87 system" his first pledge when he ran in the 2021 presidential primary. A People Power Party official said, "It appears the President sought to draw out momentum for constitutional amendment within the opposition party through golf meetings with opposition lawmakers." <<> However, some within the People Power Party suspect that the President's contacts with veteran opposition lawmakers, particularly those active on constitutional amendment, through golf meetings signal "an attempt to embrace even factions of the People Power Party and push for a new political realignment." Indeed, President Lee mentioned in a meeting with former President Moon Jae-in in July that "we must constantly expand our base and strive to create a structural majority." At the time, both ruling and opposition camps speculated whether this was "the start of a Lee Jae-myung-style grand coalition embracing moderates and conservatives." <<> Former People Power Party lawmaker Kim Young-woo also raised the possibility of the President's "new political alliance" initiative in an MBC radio interview that day, saying, "It smells of a grand coalition bringing opposition lawmakers into state affairs," and adding, "It doesn't look entirely positive. It could become a political card to shake up the People Power Party." This suggests the President's true intention may lie elsewhere, such as "resolving judicial risks," rather than constitutional amendment. <<> Both ruling and opposition camps are highly uncomfortable with the presidential office individually contacting lawmakers to propose golf outings. People Power Party lawmaker Na Kyung-won said, "The President could communicate with the opposition, but what matters is not just meeting and gathering but resolving issues. What's the point of playing golf when you don't listen to a single word we say in the National Assembly?" The pro-government Rebuilding Korea Party also stated, "While the reckoning for the insurrection is still underway, the President's golf meetings cause deep disappointment." A key Democratic Party official also said, "With the conflict between the pro-Lee and pro-Cheong Wa Dae factions intensifying, there's even talk of a split after the party convention, so I truly don't understand the President's intentions." <<> Within the ruling camp, there are also observations that once the party convention concludes, the Democratic Party will fully focus its efforts on constitutional amendment. Candidate Kim Min-seok, who is close to the President, also said on a YouTube broadcast that day, "Whether it's the President's proposal for a second term or consecutive terms, I agree with enabling two terms to ensure stability," lending support to pushing forward with constitutional amendment. Kim added, "He told me several times before the presidential election that (if constitutional amendment happens) he could shorten his own term." (이재명 대통령이 최근 국민의힘 의원들과 골프를 치면서 개헌에 관한 대화를 나눈 것을 두고 각종 해석이 나오고 있다. 공교롭게도 이 대통령과 골프 라운딩을 하거나 제안을 받은 국민의힘 의원 대부분이 당 개헌특위 소속이었기 때문이다. 야권에선 이 대통령의 골프 회동이 애초 ‘개헌 실행’을 염두에 둔 것 아니냐는 말이 나왔다. 개헌안이 국회를 통과하려면 ‘재적 의원 3분의 2 이상 찬성’이 필요하기 때문에 국민의힘 의원 109명 중 10명 이상이 찬성해야 한다. 개헌을 ‘국정 과제 1호’로 내세운 이 대통령이 골프 회동을 통해 직접 야당 의원 설득에 나선 것이란 얘기다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok Targets Lee Jin-suk... Bill Proposed to Suspend Lawmakers Who Distort or Disparage May 18 for Up to One Year (김민석, 이진숙 겨냥… 5·18 왜곡·폄훼 의원 1년 직무정지법 발의)
item.description:
Some lawmakers from the Democratic Party of Korea proposed a revision to the National Assembly Act on the 14th that would suspend the duties of lawmakers who distort or disparage the May 18 Democratization Movement for up to one year. The move appears aimed at Lee Jin-suk, a lawmaker from the People Power Party, who held a public forum the previous day at the National Assembly under the theme of "Re-examining the May 18 Democratization Movement," but if the bill passes the Assembly, concerns have been raised that disciplinary actions against People Power Party lawmakers could be overused. The Democratic Party said it is "not being pursued as a party line," but with Kim Min-seok, a leading candidate for party leadership, listed as a co-sponsor, the bill could potentially be adopted as party policy in the future. (더불어민주당 일부 의원들이 14일 5·18 민주화운동 등을 왜곡·폄훼하는 국회의원의 직무수행을 최대 1년간 정지하는 내용의 국회법 개정안을 발의했다. 전날 국회에서 ‘5·18 민주화운동의 재조명’을 주제로 공개 포럼을 연 이진숙 국민의힘 의원을 겨냥한 것이지만 이 법안이 국회를 통과하면 국민의힘 의원에 대한 징계가 남발될 가능성이 제기된다. 민주당은 “당론 추진은 아니다”라고 했으나, 유력 당권주자로 꼽히는 김민석 후보가 법안 발의자에 이름을 올리면서 향후 이 법안이 당론으로 추진될 수도 있는 상황이다.)

Lee Yong-woo, a lawmaker aligned with the pro-Lee Jae-myung faction, took the lead in proposing the revision to the National Assembly Act that day. The list of sponsors included Kim and 20 lawmakers supporting him. The revision lists grounds for discipline such as spreading false information about democratization movements and state violence whose truth has been nationally confirmed, as well as defamation, insult, slander, distortion, and fabrication. (친명계 이용우 의원은 이날 이 같은 내용의 국회법 개정안을 대표 발의했다. 발의 명단에는 김 후보와 김 후보를 지지하는 20명의 의원도 포함됐다. 개정안에는 징계 사유로 국가적으로 진상이 확인된 민주화운동·국가폭력 등에 관한 허위사실 유포와 명예훼손·모욕·비방, 왜곡·날조 등이 포함됐다.)

It is intended to discipline Lee Jin-suk of the People Power Party. The previous day, Lee held a public forum at the National Assembly Library under the theme of "Re-examining the May 18 Democratization Movement." At the event, remarks such as "To resolve the May 18 issue in the Honam region, we must isolate it externally and divide it internally" were made. In response, the Democratic Party held a rally of condemnation and even submitted a party-line resolution calling for her expulsion. (국민의힘 이진숙 의원을 징계하기 위한 것이다. 전날 이 의원은 국회도서관에서’5·18민주화운동의 재조명’을 주제로 공개 포럼을 열었다. 이 자리에서는 ‘호남 5·18 문제를 해결하려면 대외적으로는 고립시켜야 하고 내부적으로는 분열을 시켜야 한다’ 등의 발언이 나왔다. 이에 민주당은 규탄대회를 열고 당론으로 이 의원의 제명 촉구 결의안까지 제출했다.)

However, under current law, expelling a lawmaker requires the approval of at least two-thirds of all lawmakers (200 members), which is difficult with the Democratic Party's current seat count. Suspension from attendance is possible but only restricts participation in sessions for a certain period, failing to fully block a lawmaker's exercise of powers such as speaking, voting, or proposing bills. For this reason, some Democratic Party lawmakers proposed the revision to bar attendance, speaking, and voting in plenary sessions and committees for up to one year. Under the revision, they would also be unable to perform duties such as proposing or co-sponsoring bills, participating in parliamentary audits or investigations, and would not receive allowances during the suspension period. (하지만 현행법상 국회의원을 제명하려면 재적의원 3분의 2 이상(200명)의 찬성이 필요하기 때문에 지금의 민주당 의석으로는 어렵다. 출석 정지는 가능하지만 일정 기간 회의 참석을 제한하는 데 그쳐 발언·표결이나 법안 발의 등 의원 권한 행사를 전면적으로 막을 수 없다. 이 때문에 민주당 일부 의원들이 최대 1년간 본회의와 위원회 출석·발언·표결을 할 수 없도록 개정안을 낸 것이다. 개정안에 따르면 법률안 발의·공동발의와 국정감사·국정조사 참여 등 의원 직무도 수행할 수 없고, 정지 기간 수당도 지급받지 못한다.)

The People Power Party's stance is that the party leadership advised against holding the forum, but Lee Jin-suk pushed ahead anyway. Chief Deputy Spokesperson Choi Eun-seok told reporters after a floor strategy meeting that day, "The floor leadership also learned about the forum from the media," adding, "Floor leader Chung requested its cancellation before the forum, but it appears the forum was held anyway." Lee held a press conference that day and pushed back, saying, "Are they saying we shouldn't hold a forum about May 18, which they want to include in the preamble of the Constitution? Or are they saying May 18 is the Democratic Party's exclusive property, so we shouldn't touch it?" (국민의힘은 당 지도부가 포럼 개최를 만류했지만 이진숙 의원이 강행했다는 입장이다. 최은석 원내수석대변인은 이날 원내대책회의 후 기자들과 만나 “원내지도부도 언론을 보고 (포럼 개최 사실을) 알았다”며 “정 원내대표가 토론회 개최 전에 취소를 요청했는데 토론회가 강행된 것 같다”고 했다. 이 의원은 이날 기자회견을 열고 “헌법 전문에 싣겠다는 5·18을 두고 토론회를 열지 말라는 건가, 아니면 5·18은 민주당 전유물이니 건드리지 말라는 것이냐”고 반발했다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae Says "Core Support Base's Hearts Have Cooled," Pro-Lee Camp Asks "Is He Enjoying This Situation?" (정청래 “핵심 코어층 마음 식어” 친명계 “이 상황이 즐거운가”)
item.description:
Candidates for the Democratic Party of Korea's party leadership and Supreme Council positions clashed on the 14th, each offering their own interpretations of President Lee Jae-myung's approval rating, which has hit its lowest point since taking office. (더불어민주당 당대표, 최고위원 후보들은 14일 취임 후 최저치를 찍은 이재명 대통령의 국정 지지율에 대해 저마다 해석을 내놓으며 공방을 벌였다.)

Candidate Jung Cheong-rae said on BBS Radio on the 14th regarding the decline in President Lee's approval rating, "The staunch traditional support base, the core supporters who had answered 'doing very well,' have dropped off and loosened. The hearts of the traditional support base have cooled." He added, "Jung Cheong-rae has the support of the traditional support base. If I become party leader, this will be restored and the approval rating will rise—the moment I take office, the approval rating will likely go up by about 5%." (정청래 당대표 후보는 14일 BBS 라디오에서 이 대통령 지지율 하락에 대해 “‘매우 잘함’이라고 답하던 강고한 전통 지지층, 핵심 코어층이 빠지고 이완됐다. 전통적 지지층의 마음이 식었다”고 했다. 그러면서 “정청래가 전통적 지지층의 지지를 받고 있다. 제가 당대표가 되면 이것이 복원되고 지지율이 올라가 아마 제가 되는 순간 국정 지지율이 5% 정도 올라갈 것”이라고 했다.)

Pro-Lee candidates unanimously criticized Jung. Kim Yong, a Supreme Council candidate and a close aide to President Lee Jae-myung, held a press conference at the National Assembly that day and targeted Jung, saying, "Is Candidate Jung enjoying this situation? Does he think he'll become party leader at the party convention because the traditional support base's hearts have cooled and the president's approval rating has dropped?" He added, "I am very concerned that it's not the People Power Party but Candidate Jung Cheong-rae who wants the president to become an early lame duck." (친명계 후보들은 일제히 정 후보를 비판했다. 이재명 대통령의 최측근인 김용 최고위원 후보는 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 정 후보를 겨냥해 “정 후보는 이 상황이 즐거운가. 전통적 지지층의 마음이 식어서 대통령 지지율이 하락하니 본인이 전당대회에서 당대표가 될 것 같은가”라며 “대통령의 조기 레임덕을 바라는 건 국민의힘이 아니라 정청래 후보가 아닌지 매우 우려스럽다”고 했다.)

Candidate Kim Min-seok also drew a line against defining the drop in President Lee's approval rating as an exodus of the core support base. On KBS Gwangju Radio the previous day, Kim said, "If they leave because the mood isn't good, they can't be called core supporters," and "We need to unite the support base, bring in the middle ground, and move toward restoring the original approval rating." (김민석 후보도 이 대통령 지지율 하락을 핵심 지지층의 이탈로 규정하는 데 선을 그었다. 김 후보는 전날 KBS광주 라디오에서 “분위기가 안 좋다고 빠지면 코어 지지층이라고 볼 수 없다”며 “지지층을 단결하고 중간층까지 끌어들이며 원래 지지율을 회복하는 방향으로 가야 한다”고 했다.)

Candidate Song Young-gil pointed to the results of the June 3 local elections and internal party conflicts as the causes of the approval rating decline. On SBS Radio the previous day, Song said, "In the last local elections and by-elections, we won formally, but the public sentiment is that we lost in substance," adding, "Candidate Jung Cheong-rae and his support base hold the opposite view." (송영길 후보는 6·3 지방선거 결과와 당내 갈등을 지지율 하락의 원인으로 지목했다. 송 후보는 전날 SBS라디오에서 “지난번 지방선거와 보궐선거에서 형식적으로는 우리가 이겼지만 내용상으로는 졌다는 게 국민들의 여론”이라며 “정청래 후보나 그 지지 세력은 반대의 인식을 가지고 있다”고 했다.)

The Democratic Party began its public opinion poll on this day, three days before the final results of the August 17 party convention are announced. The party's next leadership will be elected by combining 70% from votes of paid party members and delegates with 30% from a public opinion poll. With only the Honam region (15th) and Seoul-Gyeonggi region (16th) paid member votes remaining, the gap between Candidate Jung and Candidate Kim stands at just 1.45 percentage points, making the public opinion poll results a major variable expected to determine the outcome. (민주당은 8·17 전당대회 최종 결과 발표를 사흘 앞둔 이날부터 국민 여론조사를 시작했다. 민주당 차기 지도부는 권리당원·대의원 투표 70%와 국민 여론조사 30%를 합산해 선출한다. 호남권(15일), 서울·경기권(16일) 권리당원 투표만을 남겨둔 가운데 정 후보와 김 후보의 격차가 1.45%포인트에 불과해 국민 여론조사 결과가 당락을 가를 주요 변수가 될 전망이다.)
