item.title: Even the 4050 demographic is wavering: President Lee's approval rating hits record low of 44% (4050도 흔들린다, 李대통령 지지율 44%로 최저치)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung's approval rating, which had maintained 50-60% levels since taking office, has dropped to a record low of 44% in a Gallup Korea poll, with a notable exodus of support among the 4050 age group, the core support base of the current administration. (이재명 대통령 지지율이 한국갤럽 조사에서 취임 후 50~60%대를 유지하다가 최저치인 44%를 찍은 가운데, 현 정권의 핵심 지지 기반인 4050세대의 지지 이탈 현상이 두드러지고 있다.)

According to a survey conducted by Gallup Korea from the 11th to the 13th targeting 1,000 adults nationwide aged 18 and over, positive evaluations of President Lee's job performance stood at 44%. This is down 7 percentage points (p) from the previous survey (51%) released on the 24th of last month. Responses saying he is "doing poorly" rose 8%p from the previous survey to 46%. (한국갤럽이 지난 11~13일 전국 만 18세 이상 1000명을 대상으로 조사한 결과 이 대통령 직무 수행에 대한 긍정 평가는 44%였다. 지난 달 24일 공개된 직전 조사(51%) 대비 7%포인트(p)가 낮았다. ‘잘못하고 있다’는 응답은 직전 조사보다 8%p 오른 46%였다.)

By region, he received support in the 30-40% range across all areas except Gwangju and Jeolla (71%). By age, all groups showed approval ratings in the 30-40% range except for those in their 40s (58%) and 50s (56%). However, approval among the 4050 demographic, the core support base of the Democratic Party, also fell by around 10% compared to the previous survey. (지역별로는 광주·전라(71%)를 제외한 전 지역에서 30~40%대의 지지를 받았다. 연령별로는 40대(58%)와 50대(56%)를 제외한 전 연령층이 30~40%대 지지율을 보였다. 다만 민주당의 핵심 지지층인 4050 지지율도 직전 조사보다 10%안팎이 빠졌다.)

President Lee's approval rating, which had exceeded 60% as recently as May just before the June local elections, has dropped about 20%p in just three months. Respondents in the Gallup poll cited real estate policies (30%), economic and livelihood issues (13%), overall poor performance (7%), reduction of prosecution powers and authoritarianism/arbitrariness (5%), and ethical concerns, including avoiding his own trial (4%), as reasons for negative evaluations. (6월 지방선거 직전인 지난 5월까지만 해도 60%대를 웃돌던 이 대통령 지지율은 3개월 만에 약 20%p 하락했다. 갤럽 조사 응답자들은 부정평가 이유로 부동산 정책(30%), 경제·민생(13%), 전반적 잘못(7%), 검찰 권한 축소와 독재·독단(5%), 도덕성 문제·본인 재판 회피(4%) 등을 꼽았다.)

The ruling party also believes that the government's recent tax reform proposal, which raises tax burdens on ultra-high-value and non-resident single-home owners, along with instability in the domestic stock market, have contributed to the declining approval rating. In particular, as the 4050 generation, once considered the "concrete support base" following the 2030 youth, begins to turn away, a sense of crisis is growing. (여당에서도 최근 발표된 초고가, 비거주 1주택자의 세 부담을 높이는 정부 세제개편안과 국내 증시 불안 등이 지지율 하락에 영향을 미친 것으로 보고 있다. 특히 2030 청년층에 이어 ‘콘크리트 지지층’으로 여겨왔던 4050도 등을 돌리기 시작하면서 위기감이 커지고 있다.)

Indeed, an analysis of opinion poll trends published by Gallup Korea over about four months, from the first week of April to the 14th (second week of August), shows that approval among those in their 40s plummeted 27 percentage points, from 85% to 58%. Approval among those in their 50s also fell 28 percentage points, from 84% to 56%. Since President Lee's inauguration, Gallup polls had shown 4050 approval ratings in the 70-80% range, but this survey marked the first time both the 40s and 50s fell below the 60% threshold. (실제 한국갤럽이 지난 4월 1주 차부터 14일(8월 2주 차)까지 약 4개월간 발표한 여론조사 추이를 분석한 결과, 40대 대통령 지지율은 85%에서 58%로 27%포인트 급락했다. 50대 지지율도 84%에서 56%로 28%포인트 떨어졌다. 이 대통령 취임 이후 갤럽 조사에서 4050 지지율은 70~80%대를 유지해 왔는데, 이번 조사에서 40·50대 모두 처음으로 60% 선이 무너진 것이다.)

During the same period, the average approval decline across all age groups was 23 percentage points (67% to 44%), and among those in their 30s it was 24 percentage points (61% to 37%), both lower than the 40s (27 points) and 50s (28 points). This suggests that the erosion of support among the 4050 generation, the engine of the current administration's governance, is proceeding faster than the decline among younger voters. (같은 기간 전체 연령대 평균 지지율 하락 폭은 23%포인트(67%→44%), 30대는 24%포인트(61%→37%)로, 40대(27%포인트)와 50대(28%포인트)보다 낮았다. 청년층의 지지율 하락세보다 현 정권의 국정 동력 기반인 4050세대의 민심 이반이 더 빠르게 진행되고 있다는 분석이다.)

In the first week of April survey, approval among progressives was 89%, but by the second week of August it had dropped 19 percentage points to 70%. A Democratic Party official said, "Initially, the 2030 generation did not have high approval ratings for the president and ruling party, whereas the 4050 generation was the ruling camp's core support base, with approval ratings near 80% for the president. But as they become disillusioned with recent government policies, the drop in their approval has been even more pronounced." (4월 1주차 조사에서 진보층의 대통령 지지율은 89%였는데, 8월 2주차에선 70%로 19%포인트 떨어졌다. 민주당 관계자는 “당초 2030세대는 대통령과 여당에 대한 지지율이 높지 않았던 반면, 4050세대는 대통령 지지율이 80% 가까이 되는 여권의 핵심 지지층이었다”며 “그런데 이들이 최근 정부 정책 등에 실망하면서 지지율 낙폭이 더 크게 나타나고 있다”고 했다.)

A similar trend appeared in the National Barometer Survey (NBS), jointly conducted and published by pollsters Embrain Public, KSTAT Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research. In the NBS's second week of April survey, President Lee's approval among those in their 40s was 79%, but by the second week of August it had fallen to 63%. Over the same period, among those in their 50s, it dropped from 85% to 67%. (여론조사 업체 엠브레인퍼블릭·케이스탯리서치·코리아리서치·한국리서치가 공동 조사해 발표하는 전국지표조사(NBS)에서도 비슷한 추이를 보였다. NBS의 4월 2주차 여론조사를 보면, 40대 이 대통령 지지율은 79%였지만 8월 2주차엔 63%로 하락했다. 같은 기간 50대는 85%에서 67%로 떨어졌다.)

Yoon Yul, a professor of political science and diplomacy at Myongji University, said in a phone call with this newspaper, "Among the 40s and 50s, the economic backbone, even progressives are angry over the turmoil in the stock and real estate markets. Ideology can't easily overcome the markets and real-world economic conditions." Park Sung-min, CEO of political consulting firm Min, predicted, "As the initial expectations for President Lee fade after taking office, the 4050 generation's assessment of the president is converging with their level of party support. With no clear momentum for the administration to engineer a rebound in approval, the exodus of the 4050, the ruling camp's allies, is likely to continue." (신율 명지대 정치외교학과 교수는 본지 통화에서 “경제적 중심축인 40·50대 중 진보층에서도 주식·부동산 시장 혼란으로 분노하는 상황”이라며 “이념이 시장과 현실 경제를 이기기는 어렵다”라고 했다. 박성민 정치컨설팅 민 대표는 “취임 초기 이 대통령에 대한 기대감이 식으면서, 4050의 대통령에 대한 평가가 정당 지지세 수준으로 수렴하는 것”이라며 “정권으로선 지지율 반등을 꾀할 만한 동력이 마땅치 않아 여권의 우군인 4050의 이탈 현상이 지속될 가능성이 있다”고 전망했다.)

The ruling party is also concerned about defections among the 2030 demographic. According to an online youth perception survey released by the Youth Future Subcommittee of the Democratic Party's National Convention Preparatory Committee, 74% of respondents answered "strongly no" or "no" to the question, "Is the Democratic Party now a party that genuinely listens to the voices of young people?" Anonymous suggestions left by young party members during the survey process included remarks such as "I'm really tired of prosecution reform" and "Policies aren't just about judicial reform." (여권은 2030 지지 이탈도 우려하고 있다. 민주당 전당대회준비위원회 청년미래분과가 공개한 온라인 청년 인식 조사에 따르면 ‘지금 민주당은 청년의 목소리를 진심으로 듣는 정당이다’라는 질문에 응답자의 74%가 ‘매우 아니다’ 또는 ‘아니다’라고 답했다. 조사 과정에서 청년 당원들이 남긴 익명 제안 중에는 “검찰 개혁 정말 지긋지긋하다” “정책이 무슨 사법 개혁만 있는 게 아니다” 등도 있었다.)

President Lee Jae-myung has also issued messages related to youth policies four times this month alone. At a youth policy expert meeting held at the presidential office (Cheongwadae) that day, President Lee said, "In our older generation, saying things like 'failure is the mother of success' or 'youth who take on challenges are beautiful' didn't get us scolded. But now, if you say 'failure is the mother of success' to young people, you'd get slapped in the face," calling for policies that align with the actual needs of young people. (이재명 대통령도 이달 들어서만 청년 정책과 관련된 메시지를 4회 내놨다. 이날 이 대통령은 청와대에서 열린 청년 정책 전문가 간담회에서 “우리 기성세대에서는 ‘실패는 성공의 어머니이다’, ‘도전하는 청년이 아름답다’ 이런 이야기를 해도 혼나지 않았다”면서 “하지만 지금 청년들에게 ‘실패가 성공의 어머니’라고 하면 뺨 맞는다”며 청년층의 실제 수요에 부합하는 정책을 주문했다.)

item.title: "Effectively a tax hike"... Pro-Lee party leadership candidates also criticize real estate policy (“사실상 증세”… 친명 당권주자들도 부동산 정책 비판)
item.description:
Amid fierce criticism from the ruling party over the government's real estate tax and supply measures, pro-Lee (Jae-myung) party leadership candidates have also begun calling for revisions and supplements. (정부의 부동산 세제·공급 대책을 두고 여당에서 거센 비판이 쏟아지고 있는 가운데 친명계 당권 주자들도 잇따라 수정·보완을 요구하고 나섰다.)

Candidate Kim Min-seok demanded a review of the government's tax reform plan on Facebook on the 14th, calling the full abolition of the long-term holding special deduction for non-resident single-homeowners "effectively a tax hike." He said, "Eliminating the holding deduction for non-resident single-homeowners is effectively a tax increase for those who own one home worth 1.2 billion won or more—equivalent to most apartments in Seoul—while not residing in it," adding, "Concerns have been raised that this could trigger side effects such as forcing tenants to vacate." (김민석 후보는 14일 페이스북에서 정부의 비거주 1주택자 장기보유특별공제 전면 폐지에 대해 “사실상 증세”라며 정부 세제개편안에 대한 재검토를 요구했다. 그는 “1주택 비거주자의 보유 공제를 폐지하는 것은 서울의 웬만한 아파트에 해당하는 시가 12억원 이상 1주택 비거주자들에게는 사실상 증세인 면도 있다”며 “임차인 퇴거 강요 등의 부작용을 초래할 수 있다는 우려가 제기된다”고 했다.)

Candidate Song Young-gil also told this newspaper the same day, "Don't touch real estate taxes," and criticized the government's plan, saying, "We're seeing 50 trillion won in additional tax revenue thanks to the semiconductor boom, so I don't understand why they're clinging to 1 trillion won from real estate taxes." Meanwhile, candidate Jung Cheong-rae did not state a clear position on the government's real estate policy, only saying, "The core of the core in real estate policy is the supply policy," and "Normalizing LH is the most urgent priority." (송영길 후보도 이날 본지에 “부동산 세금은 손대지 말라”며 “반도체 특수로 50조원의 추가 세수가 나는데 왜 (부동산 세수) 1조원에 목숨을 거는지 모르겠다”며 정부안을 비판했다. 다만 정청래 후보는 정부의 부동산 정책에 대한 정확한 입장을 밝히지 않고 “부동산 정책의 핵심 중의 핵심은 공급 정책”이라며 “LH 정상화가 가장 시급하다”고만 했다.)

As Democratic Party leadership candidates voiced opposition to the government's real estate policy in the final stretch before the August 17 party convention, ruling party figures remarked, "It shows how sensitive the real estate issue is even among core party members." The Democratic Party is conducting member voting through the 15th in Seoul and Gyeonggi, where real estate sentiment is unfavorable, and is also running a public opinion poll—which accounts for 30% of the primary results—for two days starting the 14th. A key party official said, "When even Kim Min-seok and Song Young-gil, who are close to the president, have no choice but to criticize the government's policy, it tells you how volatile public sentiment on real estate is." (민주당 당대표 후보들이 8·17 전당대회 막판 정부 부동산 정책에 반대 입장을 내자 여권에선 “핵심 당원들에게도 부동산 문제가 그만큼 민감하기 때문”이라는 말이 나왔다. 민주당은 15일까지 부동산 여론이 좋지 않은 서울·경기의 당원 투표를 진행하고, 14일부터 이틀간 경선 결과의 30%를 차지하는 국민 여론조사도 실시한다. 민주당 핵심 관계자는 “대통령과 가까운 김민석·송영길 후보가 정부 정책을 비판할 수밖에 없는 상황이니 부동산 민심이 얼마나 흉흉하다는 얘기냐”고 했다.)

At the party lawmakers' general meeting the previous day, criticism poured in over the government's real estate policy, including remarks like "If we keep going like this, both the general election and the presidential election will be a total disaster" and "President Lee Jae-myung said repeatedly that 'you can't control housing prices with taxes,' and that trust has been shattered." What the ruling party is particularly sensitive about is the strengthened taxation on non-resident single-homeowners. The concern is that if tax burdens increase even for single-homeowners who live elsewhere due to work, children's education, or caring for parents, it could trigger backlash from the middle class in Seoul and the capital region. (전날 민주당 의원총회에서도 정부의 부동산 정책과 관련해 “이대로 가다간 총선도 대선도 폭망한다” “이재명 대통령이 여러 차례 ‘세금으로 집값 안 잡는다’고 해놓고 신뢰가 깨졌다” 등의 비판이 쏟아졌다. 여당이 특히 민감하게 보는 것은 비거주 1주택자 과세 강화다. 직장·자녀 교육·부모 봉양 등의 사정으로 자기 집을 두고 다른 곳에 사는 1주택자의 세 부담까지 늘 경우 서울·수도권 중산층의 반발로 이어질 수 있다는 것이다.)

As opposition within the ruling party grows, the possibility of the government's plan being revised has increased. A Cheong Wa Dae official also said, "The real estate policy will be supplemented through sufficient discussion in the National Assembly." Within the Democratic Party, there are opinions that unavoidable circumstances—such as childcare, family care, or lease contracts—should be broadly recognized as grounds for not living in one's own home. Since the tax reform plan still has to go through the legislative process, some details could be adjusted in consultations between the new leadership and the government after the party convention. <<>> (여당 반발이 커지면서 정부안도 수정될 가능성이 커졌다. 청와대 관계자도 “부동산 정책은 국회에서 충분한 논의를 거쳐서 보완될 것”이라고 했다. 민주당에서는 육아·가족 돌봄이나 임대차 계약 등 불가피한 사유로 자기 집에 살지 못하는 경우를 폭넓게 인정해야 한다는 의견이 나온다. 세제개편안이 아직 입법 절차를 남겨둔 만큼 전대 뒤 새 지도부와 정부 간 협의에서 일부 내용이 조정될 가능성도 있다.)

item.title: Military: "Gwangju Air Base to Be Temporarily Dispersed to Seosan, Yecheon, and Chungju" (軍 “광주 군공항, 서산·예천·충주로 임시 분산 배치”)
item.description:
As the government pushes to temporarily disperse the functions of Gwangju Air Base to other military air bases by 2028 to facilitate the construction of a semiconductor cluster in the Honam region, the Ministry of National Defense announced on the 14th that it will utilize the air bases in Seosan, South Chungcheong Province; Yecheon, North Gyeongsang Province; and Chungju, North Chungcheong Province as "temporary dispersal" sites. (정부가 호남권 반도체 클러스터 건설을 위해 2028년까지 광주 군공항 기능을 다른 군공항으로 임시 분산하는 방안을 추진하는 가운데, 국방부가 충남 서산과 경북 예천, 충북 충주의 군공항을 ‘임시 분산’ 기지로 활용할 예정이라고 14일 밝혔다.)

A Ministry of National Defense official told reporters that day, "Regarding the temporary dispersal deployment, we plan to proceed using Yecheon, Jungwon (Chungju), and Seosan, taking into account minimizing impacts on operational missions and the reception capacity of each base." It is understood that the plan involves a "chain relocation" approach: the functions of the 1st Fighter Wing in Gwangju will be split and moved to the 16th Fighter Wing in Yecheon and the 20th Fighter Wing in Seosan, while some existing functions of the 16th Fighter Wing in Yecheon will be transferred to the 19th Fighter Wing in Chungju. (국방부 관계자는 이날 기자들과 만나 “임시 분산배치와 관련해 작전 운용 영향을 최소화하고, 각 기지별 수용 능력을 고려해 예천, 중원(충주), 서산을 활용해 추진할 예정”이라고 말했다. 현재 광주의 제1전투비행단의 기능을 예천의 제16전투비행단과 서산의 제20전투비행단으로 나누어 이동시키고, 예천 제16전투비행단의 기존 기능 일부를 충주의 제19전투비행단으로 이동시키는 ‘연쇄 이동’ 방식인 것으로 알려졌다.)

Earlier, President Lee Jae-myung, at the "2nd Public-Private Joint Review Meeting on Three Major Mega Projects" on the 10th, ordered that the functions of Gwangju Air Base, which had been selected as the site for the semiconductor cluster, be temporarily dispersed elsewhere to make the air base site available for use by mid-2028. The completion of Muan Air Base, the final relocation destination, is targeted for the end of 2032. This means the dispersal to the Yecheon, Seosan, and Chungju bases will last only about four years, after which operations would need to move again to Muan. (앞서 이재명 대통령은 지난 10일 ‘3대 메가 프로젝트 2차 민관합동 점검 회의’에서 호남권 반도체 클러스터 건설을 위해 클러스터 부지로 선정된 광주 군공항의 기능을 다른 곳으로 임시 분산배치해 2028년 중순까지 군공항 부지를 이용할 수 있도록 하라고 지시했다. 최종 이전 대상지인 무안 군공항의 준공은 2032년 말을 목표로 하고 있다. 결국 예천·서산·충주 기지로의 분산 배치는 4년여 정도만 지속되고, 그 후엔 다시 무안으로 옮겨야 한다는 얘기다.)

Currently, the 1st Fighter Wing in Gwangju is organized with a flight training squadron responsible for advanced flight training and a combat flight squadron performing operational missions. Although the military has not disclosed detailed dispersal plans, it is known that trainer-type aircraft and training systems will likely be concentrated at one location for efficiency. As additional personnel and aircraft are introduced, the dispersal bases will also require new hangar and maintenance facilities, office spaces, and living quarters. (현재 광주 제1비행단엔 고등비행교육 등을 담당하는 비행교육대대와 실전 임무를 수행하는 전투비행대대가 편제돼 있다. 군이 세부적인 분산 계획은 밝히지 않았지만, 훈련기 계열 항공기와 교육 체계는 효율성 차원에서 한곳에 몰아 배치할 것으로 알려졌다. 추가 인력과 항공기가 들어가는 만큼 분산 대상 기지에도 격납·정비 시설과 사무 공간, 생활 시설 등은 새로 마련해야 한다.)

Concerns have also been raised that increased flight activity at the Yecheon, Seosan, and Chungju air bases could lead to greater noise damage for nearby residents. Additionally, because Gwangju Air Base is a Combined Operations Base (COB) jointly operated by the ROK and U.S. Air Forces, where U.S. air power would be deployed in contingencies, prior consultation with the U.S. side is essential. A Ministry of National Defense official said, "We need to begin administrative procedures and necessary work as soon as possible, and the actual start of construction could be next year." (예천·서산·충주 군공항의 비행 횟수가 늘어나면서 인근 주민들의 소음 피해가 더 커질 수 있다는 우려도 나온다. 광주 군공항은 유사시 미군의 항공 전력이 전개되는 한미 공군 공동운영기지(COB)이기 때문에 미측과의 사전 협의도 필수적이다. 국방부 관계자는 “가능한 한 빨리 행정 절차와 필요한 작업을 시작해야 하며 실질적인 공사 시작 시점은 내년이 될 수 있다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Brunson Apology, Military Academies, UNC… Ahn Gyu-baek Always Speaking Inconsistently (브런슨 사과, 사관학교, 유엔사… 늘 ‘딴 말’ 하는 안규백)
item.description:
Amid reports that the United Nations Command recently launched a “Guard Armistice Enforcement Brigade,” Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-baek said on the 14th that “an agreement was reached (with the U.S.) not to (launch it),” only to change his wording to “we are consulting.” Minister Ahn, who reportedly met directly with U.S. Forces Korea Commander and UN Command Commander General Xavier Brunson at Camp Humphries last week to discuss the matter, has seen his remarks waver, raising concerns that there may be a communication problem between South Korea and the U.S. One security expert said, “Isn’t it a serious problem that the defense minister’s remarks on a major security issue are not clear?” <<> Minister Ahn met with reporters on the morning of the 14th and said, “Regarding the creation of the UN Command guard brigade and related events, we (would) probably not (go ahead) — we had discussions and reached an agreement.” Asked, “So the creation itself will not go ahead?” Minister Ahn replied, “That’s correct.” However, the UN Command reportedly has already launched the “Guard Armistice Enforcement Brigade,” which integrates the Military Armistice Commission and the UN Command Security Battalion. The UN Command did not deny the brigade’s elevation that day either, stating that it had “consistently informed Korean partners” of the brigade launch plan as well. <<> That afternoon, Minister Ahn visited the Ministry of National Defense press room and said, “On the UN Command guard brigade issue, we are communicating frequently with the UN Command side and are consulting closely within a scope that has no impact on various readiness postures.” The expression “an agreement was reached” with the U.S. had changed to “we are consulting.” <<> Asked, “So isn’t it correct that you agreed not to create (the brigade)?” Minister Ahn said, “Looking at the big picture, it’s a matter to be agreed upon bilaterally, so I think we should approach it that way.” This was interpreted as meaning that the UN Command should scrap the launch of the Guard Armistice Enforcement Brigade. The UN Command is reportedly unable to formalize the brigade’s launch due to opposition from the South Korean government.
